functions.name: extensions.grant_pg_cron_access
functions.def: CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION extensions.grant_pg_cron_access() RETURNS event_trigger LANGUAGE plpgsql SET search_path TO '' AS $function$ BEGIN IF EXISTS ( SELECT FROM pg_event_trigger_ddl_commands() AS ev JOIN pg_extension AS ext ON ev.objid = ext.oid WHERE ext.extname = 'pg_cron' ) THEN grant usage on schema cron to postgres with grant option; alter default privileges in schema cron grant all on tables to postgres with grant option; alter default privileges in schema cron grant all on functions to postgres with grant option; alter default privileges in schema cron grant all on sequences to postgres with grant option; alter default privileges for user supabase_admin in schema cron grant all on sequences to postgres with grant option; alter default privileges for user supabase_admin in schema cron grant all on tables to postgres with grant option; alter default privileges for user supabase_admin in schema cron grant all on functions to postgres with grant option; grant all privileges on all tables in schema cron to postgres with grant option; revoke all on table cron.job from postgres; grant select on table cron.job to postgres with grant option; revoke trigger on cron.job_run_details from postgres; END IF; END; $function$

functions.name: extensions.grant_pg_graphql_access
functions.def: CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION extensions.grant_pg_graphql_access() RETURNS event_trigger LANGUAGE plpgsql SET search_path TO '' AS $function$ begin if not exists ( select 1 from pg_catalog.pg_event_trigger_ddl_commands() ev join pg_catalog.pg_extension e on ev.objid = e.oid where e.extname = 'pg_graphql' ) then return; end if; drop function if exists graphql_public.graphql; create or replace function graphql_public.graphql( "operationName" text default null, query text default null, variables jsonb default null, extensions jsonb default null ) returns jsonb language sql as $$ select graphql.resolve( query := query, variables := coalesce(variables, '{}'), "operationName" := "operationName", extensions := extensions ); $$; -- Attach the wrapper to the extension so DROP EXTENSION cascades to it, -- which in turn triggers set_graphql_placeholder to reinstall the "not enabled" stub. alter extension pg_graphql add function graphql_public.graphql(text, text, jsonb, jsonb); grant usage on schema graphql to postgres, anon, authenticated, service_role; grant execute on function graphql.resolve to postgres, anon, authenticated, service_role; grant usage on schema graphql to postgres with grant option; grant usage on schema graphql_public to postgres with grant option; end; $function$

functions.name: extensions.grant_pg_net_access
functions.def: CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION extensions.grant_pg_net_access() RETURNS event_trigger LANGUAGE plpgsql SET search_path TO '' AS $function$ BEGIN IF EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM pg_event_trigger_ddl_commands() AS ev JOIN pg_extension AS ext ON ev.objid = ext.oid WHERE ext.extname = 'pg_net' ) THEN IF NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM pg_roles WHERE rolname = 'supabase_functions_admin' ) THEN CREATE USER supabase_functions_admin NOINHERIT CREATEROLE LOGIN NOREPLICATION; END IF; GRANT USAGE ON SCHEMA net TO supabase_functions_admin, postgres, anon, authenticated, service_role; IF EXISTS ( SELECT FROM pg_extension WHERE extname = 'pg_net' -- all versions in use on existing projects as of 2025-02-20 -- version 0.12.0 onwards don't need these applied AND extversion IN ('0.2', '0.6', '0.7', '0.7.1', '0.8.0', '0.10.0', '0.11.0') ) THEN ALTER function net.http_get(url text, params jsonb, headers jsonb, timeout_milliseconds integer) SECURITY DEFINER; ALTER function net.http_post(url text, body jsonb, params jsonb, headers jsonb, timeout_milliseconds integer) SECURITY DEFINER; ALTER function net.http_get(url text, params jsonb, headers jsonb, timeout_milliseconds integer) SET search_path = net; ALTER function net.http_post(url text, body jsonb, params jsonb, headers jsonb, timeout_milliseconds integer) SET search_path = net; REVOKE ALL ON FUNCTION net.http_get(url text, params jsonb, headers jsonb, timeout_milliseconds integer) FROM PUBLIC; REVOKE ALL ON FUNCTION net.http_post(url text, body jsonb, params jsonb, headers jsonb, timeout_milliseconds integer) FROM PUBLIC; GRANT EXECUTE ON FUNCTION net.http_get(url text, params jsonb, headers jsonb, timeout_milliseconds integer) TO supabase_functions_admin, postgres, anon, authenticated, service_role; GRANT EXECUTE ON FUNCTION net.http_post(url text, body jsonb, params jsonb, headers jsonb, timeout_milliseconds integer) TO supabase_functions_admin, postgres, anon, authenticated, service_role; END IF; END IF; END; $function$

functions.name: extensions.pgrst_ddl_watch
functions.def: CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION extensions.pgrst_ddl_watch() RETURNS event_trigger LANGUAGE plpgsql SET search_path TO '' AS $function$ DECLARE cmd record; obj_schema text; BEGIN FOR cmd IN SELECT * FROM pg_event_trigger_ddl_commands() LOOP -- triggers and rules have no schema of their own (schema_name is NULL), -- so use the schema of the table they belong to obj_schema := CASE WHEN cmd.object_type IN ('trigger', 'rule') THEN (pg_identify_object_as_address(cmd.classid, cmd.objid, cmd.objsubid)).object_names[1] ELSE cmd.schema_name END; IF cmd.command_tag IN ( 'CREATE SCHEMA', 'ALTER SCHEMA' , 'CREATE TABLE', 'CREATE TABLE AS', 'SELECT INTO', 'ALTER TABLE' , 'CREATE FOREIGN TABLE', 'ALTER FOREIGN TABLE' , 'CREATE VIEW', 'ALTER VIEW' , 'CREATE MATERIALIZED VIEW', 'ALTER MATERIALIZED VIEW' , 'CREATE FUNCTION', 'ALTER FUNCTION' , 'CREATE TRIGGER' , 'CREATE TYPE', 'ALTER TYPE' , 'CREATE RULE' , 'COMMENT' ) -- don't notify in case of CREATE TEMP table or other objects created on pg_temp -- also exclude any objects inside Supabase schemas AND COALESCE(obj_schema, '') NOT IN ('pg_temp', 'auth', 'realtime', '_realtime', 'storage') THEN NOTIFY pgrst, 'reload schema'; END IF; END LOOP; END; $function$

functions.name: extensions.pgrst_drop_watch
functions.def: CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION extensions.pgrst_drop_watch() RETURNS event_trigger LANGUAGE plpgsql SET search_path TO '' AS $function$ DECLARE obj record; obj_schema text; BEGIN FOR obj IN SELECT * FROM pg_event_trigger_dropped_objects() LOOP -- triggers and rules have no schema of their own (schema_name is NULL), -- so use the schema of the table they belonged to obj_schema := CASE WHEN obj.object_type IN ('trigger', 'rule') THEN obj.address_names[1] ELSE obj.schema_name END; IF obj.object_type IN ( 'schema' , 'table' , 'foreign table' , 'view' , 'materialized view' , 'function' , 'trigger' , 'type' , 'rule' ) AND obj.is_temporary IS false -- no pg_temp objects -- also exclude any objects inside Supabase schemas AND COALESCE(obj_schema, '') NOT IN ('pg_temp', 'auth', 'realtime', '_realtime', 'storage') THEN NOTIFY pgrst, 'reload schema'; END IF; END LOOP; END; $function$

functions.name: extensions.set_graphql_placeholder
functions.def: CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION extensions.set_graphql_placeholder() RETURNS event_trigger LANGUAGE plpgsql SET search_path TO '' AS $function$ DECLARE graphql_is_dropped bool; BEGIN graphql_is_dropped = ( SELECT ev.schema_name = 'graphql_public' FROM pg_event_trigger_dropped_objects() AS ev WHERE ev.schema_name = 'graphql_public' ); IF graphql_is_dropped THEN create or replace function graphql_public.graphql( "operationName" text default null, query text default null, variables jsonb default null, extensions jsonb default null ) returns jsonb language plpgsql set search_path to '' as $$ DECLARE server_version float; BEGIN server_version = (SELECT (SPLIT_PART((select version()), ' ', 2))::float); IF server_version >= 14 THEN RETURN jsonb_build_object( 'errors', jsonb_build_array( jsonb_build_object( 'message', 'pg_graphql extension is not enabled.' ) ) ); ELSE RETURN jsonb_build_object( 'errors', jsonb_build_array( jsonb_build_object( 'message', 'pg_graphql is only available on projects running Postgres 14 onwards.' ) ) ); END IF; END; $$; END IF; END; $function$

functions.name: pgbouncer.get_auth
functions.def: CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION pgbouncer.get_auth(p_usename text) RETURNS TABLE(username text, password text) LANGUAGE plpgsql SECURITY DEFINER SET search_path TO '' AS $function$ BEGIN RAISE DEBUG 'PgBouncer auth request: %', p_usename; RETURN QUERY SELECT rolname::text, CASE WHEN rolvaliduntil < now() THEN null ELSE rolpassword::text END FROM pg_authid WHERE rolname=$1 and rolcanlogin; END; $function$

functions.name: _assert_other_owner
functions.def: CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION _assert_other_owner(p_target uuid) RETURNS void LANGUAGE plpgsql STABLE SECURITY DEFINER SET search_path TO 'public' AS $function$ begin if not exists (select 1 from profiles where org_id = (select org_id from profiles where id = p_target) and role_key = 'owner' and is_approved and not deactivated and id <> p_target) then raise exception 'An organisation must keep at least one active owner'; end if; end $function$

functions.name: _set_branches
functions.args: p_org uuid, p_user uuid, p_ids uuid[]
functions.def: CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION _set_branches(p_org uuid, p_user uuid, p_ids uuid[]) RETURNS void LANGUAGE plpgsql SECURITY DEFINER SET search_path TO 'public' AS $function$ begin if exists (select 1 from unnest(p_ids) i where not exists (select 1 from branches where id = i and org_id = p_org and is_active)) then raise exception 'One or more branches are invalid for this organisation'; end if; delete from user_branches where user_id = p_user and kind = 'permanent'; insert into user_branches (org_id, user_id, branch_id) select p_org, p_user, i from unnest(p_ids) i on conflict (user_id, branch_id) do update set kind='permanent', expires_at=null, reason=null; update profiles set branch_id = p_ids[1] where id = p_user; end $function$

functions.name: _staff_guard
functions.def: CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION _staff_guard(p_target uuid, p_new_role text DEFAULT NULL::text) RETURNS uuid LANGUAGE plpgsql STABLE SECURITY DEFINER SET search_path TO 'public' AS $function$ declare me profiles%rowtype; tg profiles%rowtype; begin select * into me from profiles where id = auth.uid() and is_approved and not deactivated; if me.id is null or me.role_key not in ('owner','admin') then raise exception 'Only owners and company admins can manage staff' using errcode='42501'; end if; select * into tg from profiles where id = p_target; if tg.id is null or tg.org_id is distinct from me.org_id then raise exception 'Staff member not found in your organisation' using errcode='42501'; end if; if me.role_key = 'admin' and (tg.role_key in ('owner','admin') or p_new_role in ('owner','admin')) and tg.id <> me.id then raise exception 'Only an owner can manage owners and company admins' using errcode='42501'; end if; if p_new_role is not null and p_new_role not in ('owner','admin','branch_manager','staff') then raise exception 'Unknown role'; end if; if p_new_role = 'owner' and me.role_key <> 'owner' then raise exception 'Only an owner can grant owner' using errcode='42501'; end if; return me.org_id; end $function$

functions.name: add_org_domain
functions.def: CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION add_org_domain(p_domain text) RETURNS void LANGUAGE plpgsql SECURITY DEFINER SET search_path TO 'public' AS $function$ declare d text := lower(trim(p_domain)); begin if not is_admin() then raise exception 'Only owners and admins can manage domains' using errcode = '42501'; end if; if d !~ '^[a-z0-9]([a-z0-9.-]*[a-z0-9])?\.[a-z]{2,}$' then raise exception 'Enter a valid domain, e.g. shop.example.com'; end if; begin insert into org_domains (domain, org_id) values (d, current_org()); exception when unique_violation then raise exception 'That domain is already registered'; end; end $function$

functions.name: admin_update_staff
functions.args: p_id uuid, p_role text, p_branch uuid, p_set_branch boolean, p_deactivated boolean
functions.def: CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION admin_update_staff(p_id uuid, p_role text DEFAULT NULL::text, p_branch uuid DEFAULT NULL::uuid, p_set_branch boolean DEFAULT false, p_deactivated boolean DEFAULT NULL::boolean) RETURNS void LANGUAGE plpgsql SECURITY DEFINER SET search_path TO 'public' AS $function$ declare c profiles; t profiles; v_role text; v_deact boolean; begin select * into c from profiles where id = auth.uid() and is_approved and not deactivated; if not found or c.role_key not in ('owner', 'admin') then raise exception 'Only owners and admins can manage staff' using errcode = '42501'; end if; select * into t from profiles where id = p_id and org_id = c.org_id for update; if not found then raise exception 'Staff member not found'; end if; if t.id = c.id and (p_role is not null or p_deactivated is true) then raise exception 'You cannot change your own role or deactivate yourself'; end if; if c.role_key <> 'owner' and (t.role_key in ('owner', 'admin') or p_role in ('owner', 'admin')) then raise exception 'Only an owner can manage or grant admin/owner access' using errcode = '42501'; end if; if p_role is not null and p_role not in ('owner', 'admin', 'branch_manager', 'staff') then raise exception 'Invalid role'; end if; v_role := coalesce(p_role, t.role_key); v_deact := coalesce(p_deactivated, t.deactivated); if t.role_key = 'owner' and (v_role <> 'owner' or v_deact) and not exists (select 1 from profiles o where o.org_id = t.org_id and o.role_key = 'owner' and o.is_approved and not o.deactivated and o.id <> t.id) then raise exception 'An organisation must keep at least one active owner'; end if; if p_set_branch and p_branch is not null and not exists (select 1 from branches where id = p_branch and org_id = c.org_id) then raise exception 'Branch not in your organisation'; end if; update profiles set role_key = v_role, deactivated = v_deact, is_approved = not v_deact, branch_id = case when p_set_branch then p_branch else branch_id end, branch_reviewed = case when p_set_branch then true else branch_reviewed end where id = t.id; if v_deact then update staff_assignments set revoked_at = now(), revoked_by = c.id where profile_id = t.id and revoked_at is null; end if; end $function$

functions.name: advance_lab_orders
functions.args: p_ids uuid[], p_to text, p_note text, p_supplier text
functions.def: CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION advance_lab_orders(p_ids uuid[], p_to text, p_note text DEFAULT NULL::text, p_supplier text DEFAULT NULL::text) RETURNS void LANGUAGE plpgsql SECURITY DEFINER SET search_path TO 'public' AS $function$ declare r lab_orders%rowtype; m int; begin if current_org() is null then raise exception 'Only approved staff can update lab orders'; end if; for r in select * from lab_orders where id = any(p_ids) and org_id = current_org() for update loop if not ((r.status, p_to) in (('to_buy','ordered'),('ordered','received'),('received','edging'),('edging','fitting'),('fitting','qc'),('qc','ready'),('qc','fitting'))) then raise exception '% cannot move from % to %', r.code, r.status, p_to; end if; if p_to = 'ordered' and coalesce(nullif(trim(p_supplier),''), r.supplier_name) is null then raise exception 'Enter the supplier name'; end if; if r.status = 'qc' and p_to = 'fitting' and coalesce(trim(p_note),'') = '' then raise exception 'Describe what needs rework'; end if; update lab_orders set status = p_to, supplier_name = case when p_to = 'ordered' then coalesce(nullif(trim(p_supplier),''), supplier_name) else supplier_name end, ordered_at = case when p_to = 'ordered' then now() else ordered_at end, received_at = case when p_to = 'received' then now() else received_at end, qc_note = case when r.status = 'qc' and p_to = 'fitting' then p_note else qc_note end where id = r.id; insert into lab_events (org_id, lab_order_id, from_status, to_status, note) values (r.org_id, r.id, r.status, p_to, nullif(trim(p_note),'')); select min(case status when 'to_buy' then 1 when 'ordered' then 2 when 'received' then 3 when 'edging' then 4 when 'fitting' then 5 when 'qc' then 6 else 7 end) into m from lab_orders where sale_id = r.sale_id and status not in ('cancelled','delivered'); update sales set status = case when m = 7 then 'ready' when m = 6 then 'qc' when m >= 4 then 'in_workshop' else 'lab_pending' end where id = r.sale_id and status in ('lab_pending','in_workshop','qc','ready'); end loop; end $function$

functions.name: advance_repair
functions.args: p_id uuid, p_to text, p_note text
functions.def: CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION advance_repair(p_id uuid, p_to text, p_note text DEFAULT NULL::text) RETURNS void LANGUAGE plpgsql SECURITY DEFINER SET search_path TO 'public' AS $function$ declare r repairs%rowtype; begin if current_org() is null then raise exception 'Only approved staff can update repairs'; end if; select * into r from repairs where id = p_id and org_id = current_org() for update; if not found then raise exception 'Repair not found'; end if; if not ((r.status,p_to) in (('pending','in_progress'),('in_progress','ready'),('ready','delivered'),('pending','cancelled'),('in_progress','cancelled'),('ready','cancelled'))) then raise exception 'Cannot move repair from % to %', r.status, p_to; end if; update repairs set status = p_to where id = p_id; insert into repair_events (org_id,repair_id,from_status,to_status,note) values (r.org_id,p_id,r.status,p_to,nullif(trim(coalesce(p_note,'')),'')); end $function$

functions.name: advance_web_order
functions.def: CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION advance_web_order(p_sale uuid, p_status text) RETURNS void LANGUAGE plpgsql SECURITY DEFINER SET search_path TO 'public' AS $function$ declare s sales; rank constant text[] := array['lab_pending', 'in_workshop', 'qc', 'ready', 'delivered']; begin if not has_perm('web_orders') then raise exception 'You are not allowed to manage website orders' using errcode = '42501'; end if; if p_status <> all (rank[2:5]) then raise exception 'Invalid status'; end if; select * into s from sales where id = p_sale and org_id = current_org() and kind = 'order' for update; if not found or not exists (select 1 from online_payments where sale_id = s.id) then raise exception 'Website order not found'; end if; if not can_access_branch(s.branch_id) then raise exception 'Not authorised for this branch' using errcode = '42501'; end if; if array_position(rank, s.status) is null or array_position(rank, p_status) <= array_position(rank, s.status) then raise exception 'Order cannot move to that status' ; end if; update sales set status = p_status, updated_at = now() where id = s.id; end $function$

functions.name: apply_branch_scope
functions.def: CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION apply_branch_scope(t regclass) RETURNS void LANGUAGE plpgsql AS $function$ begin execute format('drop policy if exists branch_scope on %s', t); execute format($f$create policy branch_scope on %s as restrictive for all using (current_org() is null or branch_id is null or can_access_branch(branch_id)) with check (current_org() is null or branch_id is null or can_access_branch(branch_id))$f$, t); execute format('drop trigger if exists trg_00_branch_scope on %s', t); execute format('create trigger trg_00_branch_scope before insert or update or delete on %s for each row execute function enforce_branch_scope()', t); end $function$

functions.name: apply_movement
functions.def: CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION apply_movement() RETURNS trigger LANGUAGE plpgsql SECURITY DEFINER SET search_path TO 'public' AS $function$ declare v_cur int; v_new int; begin select qty into v_cur from stock where branch_id = new.branch_id and product_id = new.product_id for update; if not found then if new.delta < 0 then raise exception 'Not enough stock: this branch has no stock record for this item yet, so its quantity cannot be reduced by %.', abs(new.delta); end if; insert into stock (org_id, branch_id, product_id, qty) values (new.org_id, new.branch_id, new.product_id, new.delta) on conflict (branch_id, product_id) do update set qty = stock.qty + new.delta; -- A concurrent movement can land between the SELECT and the INSERT above; -- re-read so any shortfall is still reported in these words, not the -- constraint's. select qty into v_new from stock where branch_id = new.branch_id and product_id = new.product_id; if v_new < 0 then raise exception 'Not enough stock: this change would leave % on hand.', v_new; end if; else v_new := v_cur + new.delta; if v_new < 0 then raise exception 'Not enough stock: % on hand at this branch; this change would take it to %. Stock cannot go below zero.', v_cur, v_new; end if; update stock set qty = v_new where branch_id = new.branch_id and product_id = new.product_id; end if; return new; end $function$

functions.name: apply_permission
functions.args: t text, p_write text, p_read text
functions.def: CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION apply_permission(t text, p_write text, p_read text) RETURNS void LANGUAGE plpgsql AS $function$ begin if to_regclass(''||t) is null then return; end if; execute format('drop trigger if exists trg_01_perm on %I', t); execute format('create trigger trg_01_perm before insert or update or delete on %I for each row execute function enforce_permission(%L)', t, p_write); if p_read is not null then execute format('drop policy if exists perm_read on %I', t); execute format('create policy perm_read on %I as restrictive for select using (current_org() is null or has_permission(%L))', t, p_read); end if; end $function$

functions.name: approve_family_member_request
functions.def: CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION approve_family_member_request(p_request_id uuid) RETURNS jsonb LANGUAGE plpgsql SECURITY DEFINER SET search_path TO 'public', 'auth', 'pg_temp' AS $function$ declare v_org uuid := current_org(); v_role text; v_req family_member_requests%rowtype; v_member customers%rowtype; v_phone text; v_match_count integer; begin if auth.uid() is null or v_org is null then raise exception 'Authentication and active organisation are required'; end if; select role_key into v_role from profiles where id = auth.uid() and is_approved = true and deactivated = false and org_id = v_org; if coalesce(v_role, '') not in ('owner','admin') then raise exception 'You are not authorised to approve family links'; end if; select * into v_req from family_member_requests where id = p_request_id and org_id = v_org for update; if not found then raise exception 'Family request not found'; end if; if v_req.status <> 'pending' then raise exception 'This request has already been reviewed'; end if; if not exists (select 1 from customers where id = v_req.customer_id and org_id = v_org) then raise exception 'The requesting customer is no longer valid in this organisation'; end if; v_phone := regexp_replace(coalesce(v_req.member_phone,''), '[^0-9]', '', 'g'); if length(v_phone) < 10 or length(v_phone) > 15 then raise exception 'The requested mobile number is invalid. Correct the request before approval.'; end if; select count(*) into v_match_count from customers c where c.org_id = v_org and right(regexp_replace(coalesce(c.phone,''), '[^0-9]', '', 'g'), 10) = right(v_phone, 10) and lower(trim(c.full_name)) = lower(trim(v_req.member_name)); if v_match_count = 0 then raise exception 'No existing customer matches both the name and phone number. Verify the details in Customers before approving.'; elsif v_match_count > 1 then raise exception 'More than one customer matches these details. Resolve the duplicate records before approving.'; end if; select * into v_member from customers c where c.org_id = v_org and right(regexp_replace(coalesce(c.phone,''), '[^0-9]', '', 'g'), 10) = right(v_phone, 10) and lower(trim(c.full_name)) = lower(trim(v_req.member_name)) limit 1; if v_member.id = v_req.customer_id then raise exception 'A customer cannot be linked as their own family member'; end if; insert into family_members(org_id, primary_customer_id, member_customer_id, relationship, member_label, is_active) values (v_org, v_req.customer_id, v_member.id, v_req.relationship, v_member.full_name, true) on conflict (primary_customer_id, member_customer_id) do update set relationship = excluded.relationship, member_label = excluded.member_label, is_active = true; update family_member_requests set status = 'approved', reviewed_at = now(), reviewed_by = auth.uid() where id = v_req.id; return jsonb_build_object( 'request_id', v_req.id, 'primary_customer_id', v_req.customer_id, 'member_customer_id', v_member.id, 'member_name', v_member.full_name, 'vision_id', v_member.vision_id ); end $function$

functions.name: approve_family_member_request
functions.def: CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION approve_family_member_request(p_request_id uuid, p_member_customer_id uuid) RETURNS void LANGUAGE plpgsql SECURITY DEFINER SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp' AS $function$ declare v_request family_member_requests%rowtype; v_member customers%rowtype; begin if current_org() is null or not is_admin() then raise exception 'Only an organisation administrator can approve family links'; end if; select * into v_request from family_member_requests where id = p_request_id and org_id = current_org() for update; if not found or v_request.status <> 'pending' then raise exception 'Pending family request not found'; end if; select * into v_member from customers where id = p_member_customer_id and org_id = current_org(); if not found then raise exception 'Customer record not found in this organisation'; end if; if regexp_replace(coalesce(v_member.phone,''), '[^0-9]', '', 'g') <> regexp_replace(v_request.member_phone, '[^0-9]', '', 'g') then raise exception 'The customer mobile number does not match the request'; end if; if v_request.customer_id = v_member.id then raise exception 'A customer cannot be linked to themselves'; end if; insert into family_members(org_id,primary_customer_id,member_customer_id,relationship,member_label,is_active) values (v_request.org_id,v_request.customer_id,v_member.id,v_request.relationship,v_member.full_name,true) on conflict (primary_customer_id,member_customer_id) do update set relationship=excluded.relationship,member_label=excluded.member_label,is_active=true; update family_member_requests set status='approved',reviewed_at=now(),reviewed_by=auth.uid() where id=v_request.id; end $function$

functions.name: approve_staff
functions.args: p_user uuid, p_role text, p_branch_ids uuid[]
functions.def: CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION approve_staff(p_user uuid, p_role text, p_branch_ids uuid[] DEFAULT '{}'::uuid[]) RETURNS void LANGUAGE plpgsql SECURITY DEFINER SET search_path TO 'public' AS $function$ declare v_org uuid := _staff_guard(p_user, p_role); begin if not exists (select 1 from auth.users where id = p_user and email_confirmed_at is not null) then raise exception 'The staff member must verify their email first'; end if; if p_role in ('branch_manager','staff') and coalesce(array_length(p_branch_ids,1),0) = 0 then raise exception 'Assign at least one branch'; end if; update profiles set is_approved = true, deactivated = false, role_key = p_role where id = p_user; if p_role in ('branch_manager','staff') then perform _set_branches(v_org, p_user, p_branch_ids); else delete from user_branches where user_id = p_user and kind = 'permanent'; update profiles set branch_id = null where id = p_user; end if; end $function$

functions.name: approve_stock_transfer
functions.def: CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION approve_stock_transfer(p_id uuid) RETURNS void LANGUAGE plpgsql SECURITY DEFINER SET search_path TO 'public' AS $function$ declare t stock_transfers%rowtype; r record; v_role text := current_role_key(); begin select * into t from stock_transfers where id = p_id and org_id = current_org() for update; if t.id is null then raise exception 'Transfer not found'; end if; if t.status <> 'requested' then raise exception 'Transfer is not awaiting approval'; end if; if not (v_role in ('owner','admin') or (v_role = 'branch_manager' and can_access_branch(t.from_branch))) then raise exception 'Only the source branch manager or an admin can approve' using errcode='42501'; end if; if t.requested_by = auth.uid() and v_role <> 'owner' then raise exception 'You cannot approve your own request' using errcode='42501'; end if; for r in select * from stock_transfer_lines where transfer_id = p_id loop insert into stock_movements (org_id, branch_id, product_id, delta, reason, note) values (t.org_id, t.from_branch, r.product_id, -r.qty, 'transfer_out', 'Transfer ' || left(p_id::text, 8)); end loop; update stock_transfers set status = 'in_transit', approved_by = auth.uid(), updated_at = now() where id = p_id; end $function$

functions.name: approve_transfer
functions.def: CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION approve_transfer(p_id uuid) RETURNS void LANGUAGE plpgsql SECURITY DEFINER SET search_path TO 'public' AS $function$ declare t branch_transfers; begin select * into t from branch_transfers where id = p_id and org_id = current_org() for update; if not found or t.status <> 'requested' then raise exception 'Transfer is not awaiting approval'; end if; if not (is_manager() and can_access_branch(t.from_branch)) then raise exception 'Only a manager of the sending branch can approve' using errcode = '42501'; end if; if t.requested_by = auth.uid() and not is_admin() then raise exception 'You cannot approve your own request' using errcode = '42501'; end if; insert into stock_movements (org_id, branch_id, product_id, delta, reason, note) values (t.org_id, t.from_branch, t.product_id, -t.qty, 'transfer_out', 'Transfer ' || t.id); update branch_transfers set status = 'in_transit', approved_by = auth.uid(), approved_at = now() where id = t.id; end $function$

functions.name: assign_temp_branch
functions.args: p_profile uuid, p_branch uuid, p_ends timestamp with time zone, p_reason text
functions.def: CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION assign_temp_branch(p_profile uuid, p_branch uuid, p_ends timestamp with time zone, p_reason text) RETURNS uuid LANGUAGE plpgsql SECURITY DEFINER SET search_path TO 'public' AS $function$ declare c profiles; t profiles; v_id uuid; begin select * into c from profiles where id = auth.uid() and is_approved and not deactivated; if not found or c.role_key not in ('owner', 'admin', 'branch_manager') then raise exception 'Not authorised to assign staff' using errcode = '42501'; end if; select * into t from profiles where id = p_profile and org_id = c.org_id and is_approved and not deactivated; if not found then raise exception 'Staff member not found or inactive'; end if; if not exists (select 1 from branches where id = p_branch and org_id = c.org_id and is_active) then raise exception 'Branch not in your organisation'; end if; if c.role_key = 'branch_manager' and not can_access_branch(p_branch) then raise exception 'Managers can only bring staff into their own branch' using errcode = '42501'; end if; if t.role_key in ('owner', 'admin') then raise exception 'Admins already have access to every branch'; end if; insert into staff_assignments (org_id, profile_id, branch_id, ends_at, reason) values (c.org_id, p_profile, p_branch, p_ends, p_reason) returning id into v_id; return v_id; end $function$

functions.name: audit_immutable
functions.def: CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION audit_immutable() RETURNS trigger LANGUAGE plpgsql AS $function$ begin raise exception 'audit_log is append-only'; end $function$

functions.name: audit_log_immutable
functions.def: CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION audit_log_immutable() RETURNS trigger LANGUAGE plpgsql AS $function$ begin raise exception 'audit_log is append-only'; end $function$

functions.name: audit_row
functions.def: CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION audit_row() RETURNS trigger LANGUAGE plpgsql SECURITY DEFINER SET search_path TO 'public' AS $function$ begin insert into audit_log(org_id,table_name,row_id,action,old_data,new_data) values (coalesce(new.org_id,old.org_id), tg_table_name, coalesce(new.id,old.id), tg_op, case when tg_op<>'INSERT' then to_jsonb(old) end, case when tg_op<>'DELETE' then to_jsonb(new) end); return coalesce(new,old); end $function$

functions.name: branch_overview
functions.returns: TABLE(branch_id uuid, branch text, today_sales numeric, today_orders integer, month_sales numeric, month_orders integer, month_collected numeric, low_stock integer, open_repairs integer, lab_pending integer)
functions.def: CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION branch_overview() RETURNS TABLE(branch_id uuid, branch text, today_sales numeric, today_orders integer, month_sales numeric, month_orders integer, month_collected numeric, low_stock integer, open_repairs integer, lab_pending integer) LANGUAGE sql STABLE SET search_path TO 'public' AS $function$ with d as (select (now() at time zone 'Asia/Kolkata')::date as today, date_trunc('month', now() at time zone 'Asia/Kolkata')::date as m0) select b.id, b.name, coalesce((select sum(s.grand_total) from sales s, d where s.branch_id = b.id and s.kind = 'order' and s.status <> 'cancelled' and (s.created_at at time zone 'Asia/Kolkata')::date = d.today), 0), (select count(*)::int from sales s, d where s.branch_id = b.id and s.kind = 'order' and s.status <> 'cancelled' and (s.created_at at time zone 'Asia/Kolkata')::date = d.today), coalesce((select sum(s.grand_total) from sales s, d where s.branch_id = b.id and s.kind = 'order' and s.status <> 'cancelled' and (s.created_at at time zone 'Asia/Kolkata')::date >= d.m0), 0), (select count(*)::int from sales s, d where s.branch_id = b.id and s.kind = 'order' and s.status <> 'cancelled' and (s.created_at at time zone 'Asia/Kolkata')::date >= d.m0), coalesce((select sum(s.paid_total) from sales s, d where s.branch_id = b.id and s.kind = 'order' and s.status <> 'cancelled' and (s.created_at at time zone 'Asia/Kolkata')::date >= d.m0), 0), (select count(*)::int from stock k where k.branch_id = b.id and k.reorder_level > 0 and k.qty <= k.reorder_level), (select count(*)::int from repairs r where r.branch_id = b.id and r.status in ('pending', 'in_progress')), (select count(*)::int from sales s where s.branch_id = b.id and s.kind = 'order' and s.status in ('lab_pending', 'in_workshop', 'qc')) from branches b where b.org_id = current_org() and b.is_active order by b.name $function$

functions.name: bump_product_view
functions.def: CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION bump_product_view(p_id uuid) RETURNS void LANGUAGE plpgsql SECURITY DEFINER SET search_path TO 'public' AS $function$ begin insert into product_view_counts (product_id, views, today_views, counted_on) values (p_id, 1, 1, current_date) on conflict (product_id) do update set views = product_view_counts.views + 1, today_views = case when product_view_counts.counted_on = current_date then product_view_counts.today_views + 1 else 1 end, counted_on = current_date, updated_at = now(); end $function$

functions.name: can_access_branch
functions.def: CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION can_access_branch(b uuid) RETURNS boolean LANGUAGE sql STABLE SECURITY DEFINER SET search_path TO 'public' AS $function$ select coalesce(( select exists (select 1 from branches br where br.id = b and br.org_id = p.org_id) and ( p.role_key in ('owner', 'admin') or p.branch_id = b or exists (select 1 from staff_assignments a where a.profile_id = p.id and a.branch_id = b and a.revoked_at is null and a.starts_at <= now() and a.ends_at > now())) from profiles p where p.id = auth.uid() and p.is_approved and not p.deactivated), false) $function$

functions.name: cancel_order
functions.def: CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION cancel_order(p_id uuid) RETURNS void LANGUAGE plpgsql SECURITY DEFINER SET search_path TO 'public' AS $function$ declare s sales%rowtype; r record; begin select * into s from sales where id = p_id and org_id = current_org() and kind = 'order' for update; if not found then raise exception 'Order not found'; end if; if s.status not in ('lab_pending','ready') then raise exception 'Cannot cancel an order that is in production or already delivered/cancelled'; end if; if exists (select 1 from lab_orders where sale_id = p_id and status not in ('to_buy','cancelled')) then raise exception 'Lenses were already bought for this order. Contact the owner to cancel.'; end if; if s.paid_total > 0 then raise exception 'Refund all payments before cancelling (Finance → Credit Notes).'; end if; for r in select product_id, qty from sale_lines where sale_id = p_id and product_id is not null loop insert into stock_movements (org_id, branch_id, product_id, delta, reason, note) values (s.org_id, s.branch_id, r.product_id, r.qty, 'return', s.code || ' cancelled'); end loop; update lab_orders set status = 'cancelled' where sale_id = p_id; update sales set status = 'cancelled' where id = p_id; end $function$

functions.name: cashbook_from_credit_note
functions.def: CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION cashbook_from_credit_note() RETURNS trigger LANGUAGE plpgsql SECURITY DEFINER SET search_path TO 'public' AS $function$ declare v_m text; v_party text; begin -- create_credit_note() inserts the header with grand_total = 0 and fills the -- totals in afterwards, so the money only exists on the UPDATE that follows. if coalesce(new.grand_total,0) <= 0 then return new; end if; v_m := cashbook_method(new.refund_method); if v_m = 'other' then return new; end if; -- store credit / unlabelled: no cash moved select c.full_name into v_party from customers c where c.id = new.customer_id; insert into cashbook (org_id, branch_id, direction, source, source_id, amount, method, category, party, doc_code, reference, memo, sale_id, occurred_on, occurred_at, created_by) values (new.org_id, new.branch_id, 'out', 'refund', new.id, new.grand_total, v_m, 'Refund', v_party, new.code, nullif(new.reason,''), null, new.original_sale_id, (new.created_at at time zone 'Asia/Kolkata')::date, new.created_at, new.created_by) on conflict (org_id, source, source_id, entry_no) do nothing; return new; end $function$

functions.name: cashbook_from_expense
functions.def: CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION cashbook_from_expense() RETURNS trigger LANGUAGE plpgsql SECURITY DEFINER SET search_path TO 'public' AS $function$ begin insert into cashbook (org_id, branch_id, direction, source, source_id, amount, method, category, doc_code, reference, memo, occurred_on, occurred_at, created_by) values (new.org_id, new.branch_id, 'out', 'expense', new.id, new.amount, cashbook_method(new.payment_method), new.category, null, nullif(new.reference,''), new.description, new.expense_date, timezone('Asia/Kolkata', new.expense_date::timestamp), new.created_by) on conflict (org_id, source, source_id, entry_no) do nothing; return new; end $function$

functions.name: cashbook_from_online
functions.def: CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION cashbook_from_online() RETURNS trigger LANGUAGE plpgsql SECURITY DEFINER SET search_path TO 'public' AS $function$ declare v_party text; begin if new.sale_id is not null then return new; end if; -- already posted via `payments` if coalesce(new.status,'') <> 'paid' then return new; end if; select c.full_name into v_party from customers c where c.id = new.customer_id; insert into cashbook (org_id, direction, source, source_id, amount, method, category, party, doc_code, reference, occurred_on, occurred_at) values (new.org_id, 'in', 'online_payment', new.id, new.amount, 'razorpay', 'Online payment', v_party, new.razorpay_order_id, new.razorpay_payment_id, (new.created_at at time zone 'Asia/Kolkata')::date, new.created_at) on conflict (org_id, source, source_id, entry_no) do nothing; return new; end $function$

functions.name: cashbook_from_payment
functions.def: CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION cashbook_from_payment() RETURNS trigger LANGUAGE plpgsql SECURITY DEFINER SET search_path TO 'public' AS $function$ declare v_branch uuid; v_code text; v_party text; begin select s.branch_id, s.code, c.full_name into v_branch, v_code, v_party from sales s left join customers c on c.id = s.customer_id where s.id = new.sale_id; insert into cashbook (org_id, branch_id, direction, source, source_id, amount, method, category, party, doc_code, reference, sale_id, occurred_on, occurred_at, created_by) values (new.org_id, v_branch, 'in', 'sale_payment', new.id, new.amount, cashbook_method(new.method), 'Sale payment', v_party, v_code, nullif(new.reference,''), new.sale_id, (new.created_at at time zone 'Asia/Kolkata')::date, new.created_at, new.created_by) on conflict (org_id, source, source_id, entry_no) do nothing; return new; end $function$

functions.name: cashbook_from_purchase
functions.def: CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION cashbook_from_purchase() RETURNS trigger LANGUAGE plpgsql SECURITY DEFINER SET search_path TO 'public' AS $function$ declare v_delta numeric; v_no int; begin v_delta := coalesce(new.paid_amount,0) - case when tg_op = 'INSERT' then 0 else coalesce(old.paid_amount,0) end; if v_delta <= 0 then return new; end if; select coalesce(max(entry_no),0) + 1 into v_no from cashbook where org_id = new.org_id and source = 'purchase_payment' and source_id = new.id; insert into cashbook (org_id, branch_id, direction, source, source_id, entry_no, amount, method, category, party, doc_code, reference, occurred_on, occurred_at, created_by) values (new.org_id, new.branch_id, 'out', 'purchase_payment', new.id, v_no, v_delta, cashbook_method(new.payment_mode), 'Supplier payment', new.supplier_name, new.invoice_no, nullif(new.payment_ref,''), coalesce(new.payment_date, (now() at time zone 'Asia/Kolkata')::date), now(), new.created_by) on conflict (org_id, source, source_id, entry_no) do nothing; return new; end $function$

functions.name: cashbook_method
functions.def: CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION cashbook_method(p text) RETURNS text LANGUAGE sql IMMUTABLE SET search_path TO 'public' AS $function$ select case when lower(coalesce(p,'')) = 'cash' then 'cash' when lower(coalesce(p,'')) in ('upi','upi/vpa','upi transfer') then 'upi' when lower(coalesce(p,'')) in ('card','credit card','debit card','cc','dc') then 'card' when lower(coalesce(p,'')) in ('bank','bank transfer','neft/rtgs','neft','rtgs','imps','cheque','check','transfer') then 'bank' when lower(coalesce(p,'')) in ('razorpay','online','gateway') then 'razorpay' else 'other' end $function$

functions.name: claim_invitation
functions.def: CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION claim_invitation() RETURNS boolean LANGUAGE plpgsql SECURITY DEFINER SET search_path TO 'public' AS $function$ declare v_uid uuid := auth.uid(); v_email text; v_inv staff_invitations; v_name text; begin if v_uid is null then return false; end if; select lower(email), coalesce(nullif(trim(raw_user_meta_data->>'full_name'), ''), split_part(email, '@', 1)) into v_email, v_name from auth.users where id = v_uid and email_confirmed_at is not null; if v_email is null then return false; end if; if exists (select 1 from profiles where id = v_uid and org_id is not null) then return false; end if; select * into v_inv from staff_invitations where lower(email) = v_email and accepted_at is null and revoked_at is null and expires_at > now() order by created_at desc limit 1 for update; if not found then return false; end if; insert into profiles (id, org_id, full_name, role_key, branch_id, is_approved, deactivated) values (v_uid, v_inv.org_id, v_name, v_inv.role_key, v_inv.branch_id, true, false) on conflict (id) do update set org_id = excluded.org_id, role_key = excluded.role_key, branch_id = excluded.branch_id, is_approved = true, deactivated = false; update staff_invitations set accepted_at = now(), accepted_by = v_uid where id = v_inv.id; return true; end $function$

functions.name: close_stock_transfer
functions.def: CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION close_stock_transfer(p_id uuid, p_reject boolean DEFAULT false) RETURNS void LANGUAGE plpgsql SECURITY DEFINER SET search_path TO 'public' AS $function$ declare t stock_transfers%rowtype; v_role text := current_role_key(); begin select * into t from stock_transfers where id = p_id and org_id = current_org() for update; if t.id is null then raise exception 'Transfer not found'; end if; if t.status <> 'requested' then raise exception 'Only requests awaiting approval can be closed'; end if; if p_reject then if not (v_role in ('owner','admin') or (v_role = 'branch_manager' and can_access_branch(t.from_branch))) then raise exception 'Not permitted' using errcode='42501'; end if; elsif t.requested_by <> auth.uid() and v_role not in ('owner','admin') then raise exception 'Not permitted' using errcode='42501'; end if; update stock_transfers set status = case when p_reject then 'rejected' else 'cancelled' end, updated_at = now() where id = p_id; end $function$

functions.name: close_transfer
functions.def: CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION close_transfer(p_id uuid) RETURNS void LANGUAGE plpgsql SECURITY DEFINER SET search_path TO 'public' AS $function$ declare t branch_transfers; begin select * into t from branch_transfers where id = p_id and org_id = current_org() for update; if not found or t.status not in ('requested', 'in_transit') then raise exception 'Transfer can no longer be cancelled'; end if; if t.status = 'requested' then if not (t.requested_by = auth.uid() or (is_manager() and (can_access_branch(t.from_branch) or can_access_branch(t.to_branch)))) then raise exception 'Not authorised' using errcode = '42501'; end if; update branch_transfers set status = 'rejected' where id = t.id; else if not (is_manager() and can_access_branch(t.from_branch)) then raise exception 'Only a manager of the sending branch can cancel a shipment' using errcode = '42501'; end if; insert into stock_movements (org_id, branch_id, product_id, delta, reason, note) values (t.org_id, t.from_branch, t.product_id, t.qty, 'transfer_in', 'Transfer cancelled ' || t.id); update branch_transfers set status = 'cancelled' where id = t.id; end if; end $function$

functions.name: create_credit_note
functions.def: CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION create_credit_note(p jsonb) RETURNS jsonb LANGUAGE plpgsql SECURITY DEFINER SET search_path TO 'public' AS $function$ declare v_org uuid := current_org(); v_sale sales%rowtype; v_cn_id uuid; v_cn_code text; l jsonb; v_orig sale_lines%rowtype; v_sub numeric := 0; v_cg numeric := 0; v_sg numeric := 0; v_ig numeric := 0; v_total numeric := 0; v_rqty int; begin if v_org is null then raise exception 'Only approved staff can issue credit notes'; end if; select * into v_sale from sales where id = (p->>'sale_id')::uuid and org_id = v_org; if not found then raise exception 'Order not found'; end if; if v_sale.status in ('cancelled') then raise exception 'Cannot return a cancelled order'; end if; insert into credit_notes (branch_id, original_sale_id, customer_id, reason, refund_method) values (v_sale.branch_id, v_sale.id, v_sale.customer_id, coalesce(nullif(trim(p->>'reason'),''), 'Customer return'), nullif(p->>'refund_method','')) returning id, code into v_cn_id, v_cn_code; for l in select * from jsonb_array_elements(p->'lines') loop select * into v_orig from sale_lines where id = (l->>'line_id')::uuid and sale_id = v_sale.id; if not found then raise exception 'Line not found on this order'; end if; v_rqty := least(greatest(1, (l->>'qty')::int), v_orig.qty); declare v_taxable numeric := round(v_orig.taxable_value / v_orig.qty * v_rqty, 2); v_cg_a numeric := round(v_orig.cgst_amt / v_orig.qty * v_rqty, 2); v_sg_a numeric := round(v_orig.sgst_amt / v_orig.qty * v_rqty, 2); v_ig_a numeric := round(v_orig.igst_amt / v_orig.qty * v_rqty, 2); v_lt numeric := round(v_orig.line_total / v_orig.qty * v_rqty, 2); begin insert into credit_note_lines (credit_note_id, original_line_id, description, qty, unit_price, taxable_value, cgst_pct, cgst_amt, sgst_pct, sgst_amt, igst_pct, igst_amt, line_total) values (v_cn_id, v_orig.id, v_orig.description, v_rqty, v_orig.unit_price, v_taxable, v_orig.cgst_pct, v_cg_a, v_orig.sgst_pct, v_sg_a, v_orig.igst_pct, v_ig_a, v_lt); v_sub := v_sub + v_taxable; v_cg := v_cg + v_cg_a; v_sg := v_sg + v_sg_a; v_ig := v_ig + v_ig_a; v_total := v_total + v_lt; if v_orig.product_id is not null then insert into stock_movements (branch_id, product_id, delta, reason, note) values (v_sale.branch_id, v_orig.product_id, v_rqty, 'return', v_cn_code); end if; end; end loop; update credit_notes set subtotal = v_sub, cgst_total = v_cg, sgst_total = v_sg, igst_total = v_ig, grand_total = v_total where id = v_cn_id; return jsonb_build_object('id', v_cn_id, 'code', v_cn_code); end $function$

functions.name: create_organisation
functions.args: p_name text, p_branch_name text, p_branch_code text
functions.def: CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION create_organisation(p_name text, p_branch_name text, p_branch_code text) RETURNS uuid LANGUAGE plpgsql SECURITY DEFINER SET search_path TO 'public' AS $function$ declare v_uid uuid := auth.uid(); v_org uuid; v_br uuid; v_name text; begin if v_uid is null then raise exception 'Sign in first' using errcode = '42501'; end if; if not exists (select 1 from auth.users where id = v_uid and email_confirmed_at is not null) then raise exception 'Confirm your email first'; end if; if exists (select 1 from profiles where id = v_uid and org_id is not null and is_approved) then raise exception 'You already belong to an organisation'; end if; if exists (select 1 from organizations) and not exists (select 1 from platform_admins where user_id = v_uid) then raise exception 'Organisation creation is by invitation only' using errcode = '42501'; end if; if length(trim(coalesce(p_name, ''))) < 2 or length(trim(coalesce(p_branch_name, ''))) < 2 or length(trim(coalesce(p_branch_code, ''))) < 1 then raise exception 'Organisation and branch names are required'; end if; insert into organizations (name) values (trim(p_name)) returning id into v_org; insert into branches (org_id, code, name) values (v_org, upper(trim(p_branch_code)), trim(p_branch_name)) returning id into v_br; select coalesce(nullif(trim(raw_user_meta_data->>'full_name'), ''), split_part(email, '@', 1)) into v_name from auth.users where id = v_uid; insert into profiles (id, org_id, full_name, role_key, branch_id, is_approved, deactivated) values (v_uid, v_org, v_name, 'owner', v_br, true, false) on conflict (id) do update set org_id = v_org, role_key = 'owner', branch_id = v_br, is_approved = true, deactivated = false; return v_org; end $function$

functions.name: credit_notes_before
functions.def: CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION credit_notes_before() RETURNS trigger LANGUAGE plpgsql SECURITY DEFINER SET search_path TO 'public' AS $function$ begin new.code := next_code(new.org_id,'credit_note','CN-'); return new; end $function$

functions.name: current_org
functions.def: CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION current_org() RETURNS uuid LANGUAGE sql STABLE SECURITY DEFINER SET search_path TO 'public' AS $function$ select org_id from profiles where id = auth.uid() and is_approved and not deactivated $function$

functions.name: current_portal_customer_id
functions.def: CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION current_portal_customer_id() RETURNS uuid LANGUAGE sql STABLE SECURITY DEFINER SET search_path TO 'public', 'auth', 'pg_temp' AS $function$ select c.id from customers c where c.auth_user_id = auth.uid() limit 1 $function$

functions.name: current_role_key
functions.def: CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION current_role_key() RETURNS text LANGUAGE sql STABLE SECURITY DEFINER SET search_path TO 'public' AS $function$ select role_key from profiles where id = auth.uid() and is_approved and not deactivated $function$

functions.name: customer_branch_context
functions.def: CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION customer_branch_context(p_customer uuid) RETURNS jsonb LANGUAGE sql STABLE SET search_path TO 'public' AS $function$ select jsonb_build_object( 'branches_visited', (select count(distinct s.branch_id) from sales s where s.customer_id = p_customer), 'sale_count', (select count(*) from sales s where s.customer_id = p_customer), 'lifetime_value', (select coalesce(sum(s.grand_total), 0) from sales s where s.customer_id = p_customer), 'last_sale', (select jsonb_build_object('branch_id', s.branch_id, 'branch', b.name, 'at', s.created_at, 'amount', s.grand_total, 'mine', can_access_branch(s.branch_id)) from sales s join branches b on b.id = s.branch_id where s.customer_id = p_customer order by s.created_at desc limit 1)) $function$

functions.name: customers_assign_codes
functions.def: CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION customers_assign_codes() RETURNS trigger LANGUAGE plpgsql SECURITY DEFINER SET search_path TO 'public' AS $function$ begin new.customer_code := next_code(new.org_id,'customer','CUS-'); new.vision_id := next_code(new.org_id,'vision','VIS-'); return new; end $function$

functions.name: customers_protect_cols
functions.def: CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION customers_protect_cols() RETURNS trigger LANGUAGE plpgsql SECURITY DEFINER SET search_path TO 'public' AS $function$ begin if auth.uid() is null or current_setting('role', true) = 'service_role' then return new; end if; -- server/service paths if current_org() is not null then return new; end if; -- approved staff if new.auth_user_id is distinct from old.auth_user_id or new.org_id is distinct from old.org_id or new.customer_code is distinct from old.customer_code or new.vision_id is distinct from old.vision_id or new.status is distinct from old.status or new.tags is distinct from old.tags or new.notes is distinct from old.notes or new.branch_id is distinct from old.branch_id or new.referral_code is distinct from old.referral_code or new.referred_by_customer is distinct from old.referred_by_customer or new.gstin is distinct from old.gstin or new.created_at is distinct from old.created_at then raise exception 'These customer fields can only be changed by the store'; end if; return new; end $function$

functions.name: default_org
functions.def: CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION default_org() RETURNS uuid LANGUAGE sql STABLE SECURITY DEFINER SET search_path TO 'public' AS $function$ select coalesce((select org_id from site_domains where is_default limit 1), (select id from organizations where (select count(*) from organizations) = 1)) $function$

functions.name: deliver_order
functions.def: CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION deliver_order(p_id uuid) RETURNS void LANGUAGE plpgsql SECURITY DEFINER SET search_path TO 'public' AS $function$ declare s sales%rowtype; begin select * into s from sales where id = p_id and org_id = current_org() and kind = 'order' for update; if not found then raise exception 'Order not found'; end if; if s.status <> 'ready' then raise exception 'Only orders marked ready can be delivered'; end if; if s.paid_total < s.grand_total then raise exception 'Balance of ₹% is still due. Collect payment first.', (s.grand_total - s.paid_total); end if; update lab_orders set status = 'delivered' where sale_id = p_id and status = 'ready'; update sales set status = 'delivered' where id = p_id; end $function$

functions.name: enforce_branch_scope
functions.def: CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION enforce_branch_scope() RETURNS trigger LANGUAGE plpgsql SET search_path TO 'public' AS $function$ declare b uuid := case when tg_op = 'DELETE' then old.branch_id else new.branch_id end; begin if auth.uid() is not null and current_org() is not null and b is not null and not can_access_branch(b) then raise exception 'Access denied: you are not assigned to this branch' using errcode = '42501'; end if; return case when tg_op = 'DELETE' then old else new end; end $function$

functions.name: enforce_branch_write
functions.def: CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION enforce_branch_write() RETURNS trigger LANGUAGE plpgsql SECURITY DEFINER SET search_path TO 'public' AS $function$ declare v_b uuid := nullif(to_jsonb(new)->>'branch_id', '')::uuid; begin if auth.uid() is null or v_b is null then return new; end if; if not can_access_branch(v_b) then raise exception 'Not authorised for this branch' using errcode = '42501'; end if; return new; end $function$

functions.name: enforce_permission
functions.def: CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION enforce_permission() RETURNS trigger LANGUAGE plpgsql SET search_path TO 'public' AS $function$ begin if auth.uid() is not null and current_org() is not null and not has_permission(tg_argv[0]) then raise exception 'Access denied: requires permission %', tg_argv[0] using errcode='42501'; end if; return case when tg_op = 'DELETE' then old else new end; end $function$

functions.name: fill_patient_customer_id
functions.def: CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION fill_patient_customer_id() RETURNS trigger LANGUAGE plpgsql AS $function$ begin new.patient_customer_id := coalesce(new.patient_customer_id, new.customer_id); return new; end $function$

functions.name: grant_temp_branch
functions.args: p_user uuid, p_branch uuid, p_expires timestamp with time zone, p_reason text
functions.def: CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION grant_temp_branch(p_user uuid, p_branch uuid, p_expires timestamp with time zone, p_reason text) RETURNS void LANGUAGE plpgsql SECURITY DEFINER SET search_path TO 'public' AS $function$ declare me profiles%rowtype; tg profiles%rowtype; begin select * into me from profiles where id = auth.uid() and is_approved and not deactivated; select * into tg from profiles where id = p_user and is_approved and not deactivated; if me.id is null or tg.id is null or me.org_id is distinct from tg.org_id then raise exception 'Not found' using errcode='42501'; end if; if not exists (select 1 from branches where id = p_branch and org_id = me.org_id and is_active) then raise exception 'Invalid branch'; end if; if coalesce(trim(p_reason),'') = '' then raise exception 'A reason is required'; end if; if p_expires is null or p_expires <= now() then raise exception 'Expiry must be in the future'; end if; if me.role_key in ('owner','admin') then if p_expires > now() + interval '365 days' then raise exception 'Maximum 365 days'; end if; elsif me.role_key = 'branch_manager' then if tg.role_key <> 'staff' or not can_access_branch(p_branch) then raise exception 'Not permitted' using errcode='42501'; end if; if p_expires > now() + interval '30 days' then raise exception 'Managers can grant at most 30 days'; end if; else raise exception 'Not permitted' using errcode='42501'; end if; insert into user_branches (org_id, user_id, branch_id, kind, expires_at, reason) values (me.org_id, p_user, p_branch, 'temporary', p_expires, p_reason) on conflict (user_id, branch_id) do update set expires_at = excluded.expires_at, reason = excluded.reason, granted_by = auth.uid(), kind = 'temporary' where user_branches.kind = 'temporary'; -- never downgrade a permanent assignment end $function$

functions.name: handle_new_user
functions.def: CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION handle_new_user() RETURNS trigger LANGUAGE plpgsql SECURITY DEFINER SET search_path TO 'public' AS $function$ begin insert into profiles(id, full_name) values (new.id, coalesce(new.raw_user_meta_data->>'full_name', new.email)); return new; end $function$

functions.name: has_perm
functions.def: CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION has_perm(p text) RETURNS boolean LANGUAGE sql STABLE SECURITY DEFINER SET search_path TO 'public' AS $function$ select coalesce(case when r in ('owner', 'admin') then true else coalesce((select allowed from role_permissions rp where rp.org_id = current_org() and rp.role_key = r and rp.permission = p), r = 'branch_manager') end, false) from (select current_role_key() r) x $function$

functions.name: has_permission
functions.def: CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION has_permission(p text) RETURNS boolean LANGUAGE sql STABLE SECURITY DEFINER SET search_path TO 'public' AS $function$ select exists (select 1 from profiles pr where pr.id = auth.uid() and pr.is_approved and not pr.deactivated and (pr.role_key in ('owner','admin') or exists (select 1 from role_permissions rp where rp.org_id = pr.org_id and rp.role_key = pr.role_key and rp.permission = p))) $function$

functions.name: invite_staff
functions.args: p_email text, p_role text, p_branch uuid
functions.def: CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION invite_staff(p_email text, p_role text, p_branch uuid DEFAULT NULL::uuid) RETURNS uuid LANGUAGE plpgsql SECURITY DEFINER SET search_path TO 'public' AS $function$ declare c profiles; v_id uuid; v_email text := lower(trim(p_email)); begin select * into c from profiles where id = auth.uid() and is_approved and not deactivated; if not found or c.role_key not in ('owner', 'admin') then raise exception 'Only owners and admins can invite staff' using errcode = '42501'; end if; if v_email !~ '^[^@\s]+@[^@\s]+\.[^@\s]+$' then raise exception 'Enter a valid email'; end if; if p_role not in ('admin', 'branch_manager', 'staff') then raise exception 'Invalid role'; end if; if c.role_key <> 'owner' and p_role = 'admin' then raise exception 'Only an owner can invite admins' using errcode = '42501'; end if; if p_role in ('branch_manager', 'staff') and p_branch is null then raise exception 'Choose a branch'; end if; if p_branch is not null and not exists ( select 1 from branches where id = p_branch and org_id = c.org_id and is_active ) then raise exception 'Branch not in your organisation'; end if; update staff_invitations set revoked_at = now() where org_id = c.org_id and lower(email) = v_email and accepted_at is null and revoked_at is null; insert into staff_invitations (org_id, email, role_key, branch_id) values (c.org_id, v_email, p_role, p_branch) returning id into v_id; return v_id; end $function$

functions.name: is_admin
functions.def: CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION is_admin() RETURNS boolean LANGUAGE sql STABLE SECURITY DEFINER SET search_path TO 'public' AS $function$ select coalesce(current_role_key() in ('owner', 'admin'), false) $function$

functions.name: is_manager
functions.def: CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION is_manager() RETURNS boolean LANGUAGE sql STABLE SECURITY DEFINER SET search_path TO 'public' AS $function$ select coalesce(current_role_key() in ('owner', 'admin', 'branch_manager'), false) $function$

functions.name: is_prescription_expired
functions.def: CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION is_prescription_expired(p_rx_id uuid) RETURNS boolean LANGUAGE sql STABLE SECURITY DEFINER SET search_path TO 'public' AS $function$ select coalesce(valid_till < current_date, false) from prescriptions where id = p_rx_id $function$

functions.name: lab_before
functions.def: CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION lab_before() RETURNS trigger LANGUAGE plpgsql SECURITY DEFINER SET search_path TO 'public' AS $function$ begin if tg_op = 'INSERT' then new.code := next_code(new.org_id, 'lab', 'LAB-'); else new.code := old.code; new.updated_at := now(); end if; return new; end $function$

functions.name: log_export
functions.args: p_kind text, p_rows integer, p_detail jsonb
functions.def: CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION log_export(p_kind text, p_rows integer, p_detail jsonb DEFAULT '{}'::jsonb) RETURNS void LANGUAGE plpgsql SECURITY DEFINER SET search_path TO 'public' AS $function$ begin if current_org() is null then raise exception 'Not authorised' using errcode = '42501'; end if; insert into audit_log (org_id, user_id, table_name, action, new_data) values (current_org(), auth.uid(), left(coalesce(p_kind, 'export'), 60), 'EXPORT', jsonb_build_object('rows', p_rows, 'detail', p_detail, 'role', current_role_key())); end $function$

functions.name: my_permissions
functions.def: CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION my_permissions() RETURNS text[] LANGUAGE sql STABLE SECURITY DEFINER SET search_path TO 'public' AS $function$ select coalesce(array_agg(p), '{}') from unnest(array['finance_view', 'expenses', 'day_closing', 'catalogue_edit']) p where has_perm(p) $function$

functions.name: next_code
functions.args: p_org uuid, p_key text, p_prefix text
functions.def: CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION next_code(p_org uuid, p_key text, p_prefix text) RETURNS text LANGUAGE plpgsql SECURITY DEFINER SET search_path TO 'public' AS $function$ declare n int; begin if current_org() is not null and p_org is distinct from current_org() then raise exception 'Access denied' using errcode = '42501'; end if; insert into counters(org_id,key,value) values (p_org,p_key,1) on conflict (org_id,key) do update set value = counters.value + 1 returning value into n; return p_prefix || lpad(n::text, 4, '0'); end $function$

functions.name: org_default_text
functions.args: p_key text, p_fallback text, p_org uuid
functions.def: CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION org_default_text(p_key text, p_fallback text DEFAULT ''::text, p_org uuid DEFAULT NULL::uuid) RETURNS text LANGUAGE sql STABLE SECURITY DEFINER SET search_path TO 'public' AS $function$ select coalesce((select value #>> '{}' from org_settings where org_id = coalesce(p_org, current_org(), default_org()) and key = p_key), p_fallback) $function$

functions.name: org_for_host
functions.def: CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION org_for_host(p_host text) RETURNS uuid LANGUAGE sql STABLE SECURITY DEFINER SET search_path TO 'public' AS $function$ select org_id from org_domains where domain = lower(regexp_replace(coalesce(p_host, ''), ':\d+$', '')) limit 1 $function$

functions.name: palre_guard_verified_catalogue_evidence
functions.def: CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION palre_guard_verified_catalogue_evidence() RETURNS trigger LANGUAGE plpgsql SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp' AS $function$ begin if tg_op = 'DELETE' then if old.verification_status = 'verified' then raise exception 'Verified PALRE evidence cannot be deleted; supersede it and create a new version'; end if; return old; end if; if old.verification_status = 'verified' then if new.verification_status <> 'superseded' or (to_jsonb(new) - 'verification_status' - 'created_at') <> (to_jsonb(old) - 'verification_status' - 'created_at') then raise exception 'Verified PALRE evidence is immutable; create a new version'; end if; end if; return new; end $function$

functions.name: palre_guard_verified_option_combination
functions.def: CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION palre_guard_verified_option_combination() RETURNS trigger LANGUAGE plpgsql SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp' AS $function$ declare v_status text; begin if tg_table_name = 'lens_package_option_combinations' then if tg_op = 'DELETE' and old.verification_status = 'verified' then raise exception 'Verified option combinations cannot be deleted; supersede them'; end if; if tg_op = 'UPDATE' and old.verification_status = 'verified' and (new.verification_status <> 'superseded' or (to_jsonb(new) - 'verification_status' - 'created_at') <> (to_jsonb(old) - 'verification_status' - 'created_at')) then raise exception 'Verified option combinations are immutable; create a new combination'; end if; if tg_op = 'DELETE' then return old; end if; return new; end if; select verification_status into v_status from lens_package_option_combinations where org_id = old.org_id and id = old.combination_id; if v_status = 'verified' then raise exception 'Items in a verified option combination are immutable'; end if; if tg_op = 'UPDATE' then select verification_status into v_status from lens_package_option_combinations where org_id = new.org_id and id = new.combination_id; if v_status = 'verified' then raise exception 'Items cannot be moved into a verified option combination'; end if; end if; if tg_op = 'DELETE' then return old; end if; return new; end $function$

functions.name: palre_recommendation_event_no_mutation
functions.def: CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION palre_recommendation_event_no_mutation() RETURNS trigger LANGUAGE plpgsql SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp' AS $function$ begin raise exception 'PALRE recommendation events are append-only'; end $function$

functions.name: palre_validate_compatibility_design_family
functions.def: CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION palre_validate_compatibility_design_family() RETURNS trigger LANGUAGE plpgsql SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp' AS $function$ declare v_design text; begin select design into v_design from lens_packages where id=new.lens_package_id and org_id=new.org_id; if not found then raise exception 'Lens package does not exist in this organisation'; end if; if (v_design='single_vision' and new.design_family<>'SV') or (v_design='bifocal' and new.design_family<>'BF') or (v_design='progressive' and new.design_family<>'PROG') or (v_design='occupational' and new.design_family<>'OCC') or v_design not in ('single_vision','bifocal','progressive','occupational') then raise exception 'Compatibility rule design family does not match lens package design'; end if; return new; end $function$

functions.name: palre_validate_option_combination
functions.def: CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION palre_validate_option_combination() RETURNS trigger LANGUAGE plpgsql SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp' AS $function$ declare v_package_id uuid; v_option_package_id uuid; v_status text; v_combo_status text; v_count integer; begin if tg_table_name = 'lens_package_option_combinations' then if new.verification_status = 'verified' then select count(*) into v_count from lens_package_option_combination_items i where i.org_id = new.org_id and i.combination_id = new.id; if v_count < 2 then raise exception 'A verified option combination must contain at least two verified package options'; end if; end if; return new; end if; select lens_package_id, verification_status into v_option_package_id, v_status from lens_package_option_eligibility where org_id = new.org_id and id = new.package_option_eligibility_id; select lens_package_id, verification_status into v_package_id, v_combo_status from lens_package_option_combinations where org_id = new.org_id and id = new.combination_id; if v_combo_status = 'verified' then raise exception 'Items in a verified option combination are immutable'; end if; if v_package_id is null or v_option_package_id is null or v_package_id <> v_option_package_id or v_status <> 'verified' then raise exception 'Combination items must reference verified options belonging to the same package and organisation'; end if; return new; end $function$

functions.name: payments_apply
functions.def: CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION payments_apply() RETURNS trigger LANGUAGE plpgsql SECURITY DEFINER SET search_path TO 'public' AS $function$ declare s sales%rowtype; begin select * into s from sales where id = new.sale_id for update; if s.kind <> 'order' then raise exception 'Payments can only be taken on orders'; end if; if s.status = 'cancelled' then raise exception 'This order is cancelled'; end if; if s.paid_total + new.amount > s.grand_total then raise exception 'That is more than the balance due'; end if; update sales set paid_total = s.paid_total + new.amount, payment_status = case when s.paid_total + new.amount >= s.grand_total then 'paid' else 'partial' end where id = s.id; return new; end $function$

functions.name: place_sale
functions.def: CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION place_sale(p jsonb) RETURNS jsonb LANGUAGE plpgsql AS $function$ declare v_org uuid := current_org(); v_kind text := p->>'kind'; v_cust uuid := (p->>'customer_id')::uuid; v_branch uuid := (p->>'branch_id')::uuid; v_rx_id uuid := (p->>'prescription_id')::uuid; v_qid uuid := (p->>'quotation_id')::uuid; v_rx jsonb; v_role text; v_maxdisc numeric; v_gst boolean := coalesce((select (value #>> '{}')::boolean from org_settings where org_id = current_org() and key = 'gst_enabled'), true); v_lead int := coalesce((select (value #>> '{}')::int from org_settings where org_id = current_org() and key = 'lab_lead_days'), 5); v_supply_type text := coalesce(nullif(p->>'supply_type',''), 'intrastate'); v_state_of_supply text := coalesce(nullif(p->>'state_of_supply',''), 'Tamil Nadu'); v_recipient_gstin text := nullif(trim(coalesce(p->>'recipient_gstin','')), ''); v_id uuid; v_code text; v_lid uuid; l jsonb; n int := 0; v_type text; v_qty int; v_disc numeric; v_unit numeric; v_tax numeric; v_desc text; v_det text; v_hsn text; v_pmode text; v_taxable numeric; v_tax_amt numeric; v_cgst_p numeric; v_sgst_p numeric; v_igst_p numeric; v_cgst_a numeric; v_sgst_a numeric; v_igst_a numeric; v_tot numeric; -- subtotal = sum of listed prices (before discount), always inclusive-of-tax -- grand_total = sum of actual amounts paid v_sub numeric := 0; v_grand numeric := 0; v_taxable_tot numeric := 0; v_cgst_tot numeric := 0; v_sgst_tot numeric := 0; v_igst_tot numeric := 0; v_lab boolean := false; v_pkind text; v_fdesc text; v_fpid uuid; v_pid uuid; v_have int; v_pkg lens_packages%rowtype; v_opts uuid[]; v_optsum numeric; v_optnames text; v_pay numeric := coalesce((p->'payment'->>'amount')::numeric, 0); v_idem text := nullif(p->>'idempotency_key', ''); -- Track inserted sale lines' product IDs for stock deduction v_product_ids uuid[] := '{}'; begin -- ── Organisational context security check ──────────────────────────────────────── -- Ensure the caller is validated under an approved organisation context. -- If no org is found, raise immediately (prevents anonymous/unvalidated execution). if v_org is null then raise exception 'Only approved staff can create sales'; end if; -- ── Sale type validation ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────── if v_kind not in ('quotation','order') then raise exception 'Unknown sale type'; end if; -- ── Role validation ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────── select role_key into v_role from profiles where id = auth.uid(); v_maxdisc := coalesce((select (value #>> '{}')::numeric from org_settings where org_id = v_org and key = 'max_staff_discount_pct'), 10); -- ── Customer & branch validation ───────────────────────────────────────────────── if not exists (select 1 from customers where id = v_cust) then raise exception 'Choose a customer'; end if; if not exists (select 1 from branches where id = v_branch) then raise exception 'Choose a branch'; end if; -- ── Prescription validation ────────────────────────────────────────────────────── if v_rx_id is not null then select to_jsonb(r) into v_rx from prescriptions r where r.id = v_rx_id and r.customer_id = v_cust; if v_rx is null then raise exception 'That prescription does not belong to this customer'; end if; end if; -- ── Quotation validation ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────── if v_qid is not null and not exists (select 1 from sales where id = v_qid and kind = 'quotation' and status in ('draft','sent')) then raise exception 'That quotation can no longer be converted'; end if; -- ── Idempotency check: return existing sale if same key already submitted ────────── if v_idem is not null and v_idem <> '' then select id, code into v_id, v_code from sales where org_id = v_org and idempotency_key = v_idem::uuid limit 1; if v_id is not null then return jsonb_build_object('id', v_id, 'code', v_code, 'idempotent', true); end if; end if; -- ── Ensure at least one line item ──────────────────────────────────────────────── if jsonb_array_length(coalesce(p->'lines','[]'::jsonb)) = 0 then raise exception 'Add at least one item'; end if; -- ── Insert the sale header with full GST context ───────────────────────────────── insert into sales (branch_id, kind, customer_id, prescription_id, rx_snapshot, source_quotation_id, status, notes, gst_applied, supply_type, state_of_supply, recipient_gstin, valid_until) values (v_branch, v_kind, v_cust, v_rx_id, v_rx, v_qid, 'draft', nullif(p->>'notes',''), v_gst, v_supply_type, v_state_of_supply, v_recipient_gstin, case when v_kind = 'quotation' then coalesce((p->>'valid_until')::date, current_date + coalesce((select (value #>> '{}')::int from org_settings where org_id = v_org and key = 'quotation_valid_days'), 14)) end) returning id, code into v_id, v_code; -- ── Process each line item ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────── for l in select * from jsonb_array_elements(p->'lines') loop n := n + 1; v_type := l->>'line_type'; v_pid := null; v_det := null; v_opts := '{}'; v_hsn := null; v_pmode := 'inclusive'; v_qty := greatest(1, coalesce((l->>'qty')::int, 1)); v_disc := coalesce((l->>'discount_pct')::numeric, 0); if v_disc < 0 or v_disc > 100 then raise exception 'Discount must be between 0 and 100'; end if; if v_disc > v_maxdisc and coalesce(v_role,'') not in ('owner','admin') then raise exception 'Discounts above % need an owner or admin', v_maxdisc; end if; -- ── Lens items ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────── if v_type = 'lens' then select * into v_pkg from lens_packages where id = (l->>'lens_package_id')::uuid and status = 'active'; if not found then raise exception 'Choose an active lens package'; end if; v_opts := array(select jsonb_array_elements_text(coalesce(l->'option_ids','[]'::jsonb))::uuid); select coalesce(sum(price),0), string_agg(name, ', ' order by display_order) into v_optsum, v_optnames from lens_options where id = any(v_opts) and status = 'active'; v_unit := v_pkg.base_price + v_optsum; v_tax := v_pkg.tax_pct; v_desc := v_pkg.name || ' lenses'; v_det := v_optnames; v_hsn := '900150'; v_pmode := 'inclusive'; v_lab := true; -- ── Frame-only (no prescription) → no lab job ────────────────────────────── -- If there is no prescription, this is a frame-only sale: skip lab order creation -- but still record the sale. Lab jobs only happen when a prescription exists. if v_rx is null then v_lab := false; end if; -- ── Product/accessory items ─────────────────────────────────────────────────── elsif v_type in ('product','accessory') then v_pid := (l->>'product_id')::uuid; select p2.selling_price, p2.tax_pct, trim(coalesce(b.name,'') || ' ' || p2.model), p2.kind, coalesce(p2.hsn,''), p2.price_mode into v_unit, v_tax, v_desc, v_pkind, v_hsn, v_pmode from products p2 left join brands b on b.id = p2.brand_id where p2.id = v_pid and p2.status = 'active'; if v_unit is null then raise exception 'An item in the bag is no longer available'; end if; if v_pkind in ('frame','sunglass') then v_fdesc := v_desc; v_fpid := v_pid; end if; if v_kind = 'order' then select qty into v_have from stock where branch_id = v_branch and product_id = v_pid; v_have := coalesce(v_have, 0); if v_have < v_qty then raise exception 'Not enough stock for % (only % here)', v_desc, v_have; end if; end if; -- ── Service items ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────── elsif v_type = 'service' then v_unit := (l->>'unit_price')::numeric; v_tax := coalesce((l->>'tax_pct')::numeric, 18); v_desc := nullif(trim(l->>'description'), ''); if v_desc is null or v_unit is null or v_unit < 0 then raise exception 'Service items need a name and a price'; end if; v_hsn := '999999'; v_pmode := 'exclusive'; else raise exception 'Unknown item type: %', v_type; end if; -- ── GST: disable tax if org setting says so ──────────────────────────────────── if not v_gst then v_tax := 0; end if; -- ── Price / tax calculation (exclusive vs inclusive) ────────────────────────── if v_pmode = 'exclusive' then v_taxable := round(v_qty * v_unit * (1 - v_disc/100), 2); v_tax_amt := round(v_taxable * v_tax / 100, 2); v_tot := v_taxable + v_tax_amt; -- Subtotal for exclusive = full price including tax (MRP equivalent) v_sub := v_sub + round(v_qty * v_unit * (1 + v_tax/100), 2); else -- inclusive (default for Indian retail) v_tot := round(v_qty * v_unit * (1 - v_disc/100), 2); v_taxable := case when v_tax > 0 then round(v_tot / (1 + v_tax/100), 2) else v_tot end; v_tax_amt := v_tot - v_taxable; v_sub := v_sub + v_qty * v_unit; end if; -- ── CGST/SGST vs IGST split ────────────────────────────────────────────────── if v_gst and v_supply_type = 'intrastate' then v_cgst_p := v_tax/2; v_sgst_p := v_tax/2; v_igst_p := 0; v_cgst_a := round(v_tax_amt/2, 2); v_sgst_a := v_tax_amt - round(v_tax_amt/2,2); v_igst_a := 0; elsif v_gst then v_cgst_p := 0; v_sgst_p := 0; v_igst_p := v_tax; v_cgst_a := 0; v_sgst_a := 0; v_igst_a := v_tax_amt; else v_cgst_p := 0; v_sgst_p := 0; v_igst_p := 0; v_cgst_a := 0; v_sgst_a := 0; v_igst_a := 0; end if; v_grand := v_grand + v_tot; v_taxable_tot := v_taxable_tot + v_taxable;
