v_cgst_tot := v_cgst_tot + v_cgst_a; v_sgst_tot := v_sgst_tot + v_sgst_a; v_igst_tot := v_igst_tot + v_igst_a; -- ── Insert sale line with all GST fields ────────────────────────────────────── insert into sale_lines (sale_id, line_no, line_type, product_id, lens_package_id, option_ids, description, details, qty, unit_price, discount_pct, tax_pct, line_total, hsn, price_mode, taxable_value, cgst_pct, cgst_amt, sgst_pct, sgst_amt, igst_pct, igst_amt) values (v_id, n, v_type, v_pid, case when v_type = 'lens' then v_pkg.id end, v_opts, v_desc, v_det, v_qty, v_unit, v_disc, v_tax, v_tot, v_hsn, v_pmode, v_taxable, v_cgst_p, v_cgst_a, v_sgst_p, v_sgst_a, v_igst_p, v_igst_a) returning id into v_lid; -- ── Stock deduction for product/accessory orders ─────────────────────────────── if v_kind = 'order' and v_pid is not null then insert into stock_movements (branch_id, product_id, delta, reason, note) values (v_branch, v_pid, -v_qty, 'sale', v_code); v_product_ids := v_product_ids || array[v_pid]; end if; -- ── Lab order creation for prescription lens orders ONLY ───────────────────── -- Rule: lab_orders are created only when: -- 1. v_kind = 'order' (actual order, not quotation) -- 2. v_type = 'lens' (lens item) -- 3. v_rx is not null (prescription exists) -- This ensures: -- - Frame-only sales (frame sunglasses without prescription) do NOT create lab jobs -- - Quotations do NOT create lab jobs -- - Product/accessory orders do NOT create lab jobs if v_kind = 'order' and v_type = 'lens' and v_rx is not null then insert into lab_orders (branch_id, sale_id, sale_line_id, customer_id, lens_package_id, lens_desc, lens_details, frame_desc, frame_product_id, rx_code, od_sph, od_cyl, od_axis, od_add, os_sph, os_cyl, os_axis, os_add, pd_far, pd_near, due_date) values (v_branch, v_id, v_lid, v_cust, v_pkg.id, v_desc, v_det, v_fdesc, v_fpid, v_rx->>'rx_code', (v_rx->>'od_sph')::numeric, (v_rx->>'od_cyl')::numeric, (v_rx->>'od_axis')::int, (v_rx->>'od_add')::numeric, (v_rx->>'os_sph')::numeric, (v_rx->>'os_cyl')::numeric, (v_rx->>'os_axis')::int, (v_rx->>'os_add')::numeric, (v_rx->>'pd_far')::numeric, (v_rx->>'pd_near')::numeric, current_date + v_lead); end if; end loop; -- ── Validate lens orders require prescription ──────────────────────────────────── if v_kind = 'order' and v_lab and v_rx is null then raise exception 'Lens orders need a prescription. Add one first.'; end if; -- ── Update sale totals with all GST aggregates ────────────────────────────────── update sales set subtotal = v_sub, -- FIX: discount_total = listed price − what customer pays (always ≥ 0) discount_total = greatest(0, round(v_sub - v_grand, 2)), tax_included = v_cgst_tot + v_sgst_tot + v_igst_tot, grand_total = v_grand, taxable_total = v_taxable_tot, cgst_total = v_cgst_tot, sgst_total = v_sgst_tot, igst_total = v_igst_tot, needs_lab = v_lab, status = case when v_kind = 'quotation' then 'draft' when v_lab then 'lab_pending' else 'ready' end, gst_applied = v_gst, supply_type = v_supply_type, state_of_supply = v_state_of_supply, recipient_gstin = v_recipient_gstin, idempotency_key = v_idem::uuid where id = v_id; -- ── Convert quotation if referencing one ───────────────────────────────────────── if v_qid is not null then update sales set status = 'converted' where id = v_qid; end if; -- ── Insert payment if amount provided ─────────────────────────────────────────── if v_kind = 'order' and v_pay > 0 then insert into payments (sale_id, amount, method, reference) values (v_id, v_pay, coalesce(p->'payment'->>'method','cash'), nullif(p->'payment'->>'reference','')); end if; return jsonb_build_object('id', v_id, 'code', v_code); end $function$

functions.name: portal_family_members
functions.returns: TABLE(id uuid, full_name text, vision_id text, relationship text)
functions.def: CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION portal_family_members() RETURNS TABLE(id uuid, full_name text, vision_id text, relationship text) LANGUAGE sql STABLE SECURITY DEFINER SET search_path TO 'public', 'auth', 'pg_temp' AS $function$ with me as ( select c.id from customers c where c.auth_user_id = auth.uid() limit 1 ) select c.id, c.full_name, c.vision_id, 'You'::text as relationship from customers c join me on me.id = c.id union all select member.id, member.full_name, member.vision_id, fm.relationship from family_members fm join me on me.id = fm.primary_customer_id join customers member on member.id = fm.member_customer_id where fm.is_active = true $function$

functions.name: portal_notify_appointment
functions.def: CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION portal_notify_appointment() RETURNS trigger LANGUAGE plpgsql SECURITY DEFINER SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp' AS $function$ declare v_title text; v_body text; v_key text; begin if tg_op = 'UPDATE' then if old.status is not distinct from new.status then return new; end if; end if; v_title := case when tg_op = 'INSERT' then 'Eye test appointment requested' else 'Eye test appointment updated' end; v_body := to_char(new.appt_date, 'DD Mon YYYY') || ' at ' || to_char(new.appt_time, 'HH12:MI AM') || ' · ' || replace(new.status, '_', ' '); v_key := 'appointment:' || new.id::text || ':' || new.status; insert into customer_notifications(org_id, customer_id, notification_type, title, body, href, source_key) values (new.org_id, new.customer_id, 'appointment', v_title, v_body, '/my/appointments', v_key) on conflict (customer_id, source_key) do nothing; return new; end $function$

functions.name: portal_notify_loyalty
functions.def: CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION portal_notify_loyalty() RETURNS trigger LANGUAGE plpgsql SECURITY DEFINER SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp' AS $function$ begin insert into customer_notifications(org_id, customer_id, notification_type, title, body, href, source_key) values (new.org_id, new.customer_id, 'loyalty', case when new.delta > 0 then '+' || new.delta::text || ' loyalty points earned' else abs(new.delta)::text || ' loyalty points redeemed' end, replace(new.reason, '_', ' '), '/my/loyalty', 'loyalty:' || new.id::text) on conflict (customer_id, source_key) do nothing; return new; end $function$

functions.name: portal_notify_order
functions.def: CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION portal_notify_order() RETURNS trigger LANGUAGE plpgsql SECURITY DEFINER SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp' AS $function$ declare v_title text; v_body text; v_key text; begin if new.kind <> 'order' then return new; end if; if tg_op = 'UPDATE' then if old.status is not distinct from new.status then return new; end if; end if; if tg_op = 'INSERT' then v_title := 'Order #' || coalesce(new.code, ''); v_body := case new.status when 'ready' then 'Your order is ready for pickup.' when 'delivered' then 'Your order has been delivered.' when 'cancelled' then 'Your order was cancelled.' else 'Your order has been placed successfully.' end; v_key := 'order:' || new.id::text || ':created'; else v_title := 'Order #' || coalesce(new.code, '') || ' updated'; v_body := case new.status when 'processing' then 'Your order is being prepared.' when 'lab_pending' then 'Your lenses are at the lab.' when 'in_workshop' then 'Your order is in the workshop.' when 'qc' then 'Your order is in quality check.' when 'ready' then 'Your order is ready for pickup.' when 'delivered' then 'Your order has been delivered.' when 'cancelled' then 'Your order was cancelled.' else 'Your order status is now ' || replace(new.status, '_', ' ') || '.' end; v_key := 'order:' || new.id::text || ':status:' || new.status; end if; insert into customer_notifications(org_id, customer_id, notification_type, title, body, href, source_key) values (new.org_id, new.customer_id, 'order', v_title, v_body, '/my/orders/' || new.id::text, v_key) on conflict (customer_id, source_key) do nothing; return new; end $function$

functions.name: portal_notify_prescription
functions.def: CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION portal_notify_prescription() RETURNS trigger LANGUAGE plpgsql SECURITY DEFINER SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp' AS $function$ begin insert into customer_notifications(org_id, customer_id, notification_type, title, body, href, source_key) values (new.org_id, new.customer_id, 'prescription', 'Prescription added', 'Your prescription ' || coalesce(new.rx_code, '') || ' is now available in your Vision ID.', '/my/prescriptions', 'prescription:' || new.id::text) on conflict (customer_id, source_key) do nothing; return new; end $function$

functions.name: prescriptions_assign_code
functions.def: CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION prescriptions_assign_code() RETURNS trigger LANGUAGE plpgsql SECURITY DEFINER SET search_path TO 'public' AS $function$ begin new.rx_code := next_code(new.org_id,'rx','RX-'); return new; end $function$

functions.name: prescriptions_check_values
functions.def: CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION prescriptions_check_values() RETURNS trigger LANGUAGE plpgsql SET search_path TO 'public' AS $function$ begin if new.od_axis is not null and new.od_axis not between 0 and 180 then raise exception 'Right eye (OD) axis must be between 0 and 180 — got %.', new.od_axis; end if; if new.os_axis is not null and new.os_axis not between 0 and 180 then raise exception 'Left eye (OS) axis must be between 0 and 180 — got %.', new.os_axis; end if; if new.od_sph is not null and new.od_sph not between -99.99 and 99.99 then raise exception 'Right eye (OD) SPH is out of range (−99.99 to +99.99) — got %.', new.od_sph; end if; if new.os_sph is not null and new.os_sph not between -99.99 and 99.99 then raise exception 'Left eye (OS) SPH is out of range (−99.99 to +99.99) — got %.', new.os_sph; end if; if new.od_cyl is not null and new.od_cyl not between -99.99 and 99.99 then raise exception 'Right eye (OD) CYL is out of range (−99.99 to +99.99) — got %.', new.od_cyl; end if; if new.os_cyl is not null and new.os_cyl not between -99.99 and 99.99 then raise exception 'Left eye (OS) CYL is out of range (−99.99 to +99.99) — got %.', new.os_cyl; end if; if new.od_add is not null and new.od_add not between -99.99 and 99.99 then raise exception 'Right eye (OD) ADD is out of range (−99.99 to +99.99) — got %.', new.od_add; end if; if new.os_add is not null and new.os_add not between -99.99 and 99.99 then raise exception 'Left eye (OS) ADD is out of range (−99.99 to +99.99) — got %.', new.os_add; end if; if new.pd_far is not null and new.pd_far not between -999.9 and 999.9 then raise exception 'Distance PD is out of range (−999.9 to +999.9) — got %.', new.pd_far; end if; if new.pd_near is not null and new.pd_near not between -999.9 and 999.9 then raise exception 'Near PD is out of range (−999.9 to +999.9) — got %.', new.pd_near; end if; return new; end $function$

functions.name: product_costs_guard
functions.def: CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION product_costs_guard() RETURNS trigger LANGUAGE plpgsql AS $function$ begin if not exists (select 1 from products p where p.id = new.product_id and p.org_id = new.org_id) then raise exception 'Product not in your organisation' using errcode = '42501'; end if; new.updated_at := now(); new.updated_by := auth.uid(); return new; end $function$

functions.name: products_before
functions.def: CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION products_before() RETURNS trigger LANGUAGE plpgsql SECURITY DEFINER SET search_path TO 'public' AS $function$ begin if tg_op = 'INSERT' then new.sku := next_code(new.org_id, 'sku_' || new.kind, case new.kind when 'frame' then 'FRM-' when 'sunglass' then 'SUN-' when 'contact_lens' then 'CL-' else 'ACC-' end); new.barcode := coalesce(nullif(new.barcode, ''), new.sku); else new.sku := old.sku; new.updated_at := now(); end if; return new; end $function$

functions.name: purchase_orders_no
functions.def: CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION purchase_orders_no() RETURNS trigger LANGUAGE plpgsql SECURITY DEFINER SET search_path TO 'public' AS $function$ begin if new.po_no is null or new.po_no = '' then new.po_no := next_code(new.org_id, 'purchase_order', 'PO-'); end if; return new; end $function$

functions.name: rate_limit_hit
functions.args: p_key text, p_limit integer, p_window_secs integer
functions.def: CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION rate_limit_hit(p_key text, p_limit integer, p_window_secs integer) RETURNS boolean LANGUAGE plpgsql SECURITY DEFINER SET search_path TO 'public' AS $function$ declare w timestamptz := to_timestamp(floor(extract(epoch from now()) / p_window_secs) * p_window_secs); h int; begin insert into rate_limits (key, window_start) values (left(p_key, 200), w) on conflict (key, window_start) do update set hits = rate_limits.hits + 1 returning hits into h; if random() < 0.02 then delete from rate_limits where window_start < now() - interval '1 day'; end if; return h <= p_limit; end $function$

functions.name: receive_stock_transfer
functions.def: CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION receive_stock_transfer(p_id uuid) RETURNS void LANGUAGE plpgsql SECURITY DEFINER SET search_path TO 'public' AS $function$ declare t stock_transfers%rowtype; r record; begin select * into t from stock_transfers where id = p_id and org_id = current_org() for update; if t.id is null then raise exception 'Transfer not found'; end if; if t.status <> 'in_transit' then raise exception 'Transfer is not in transit'; end if; if not can_access_branch(t.to_branch) then raise exception 'Only the receiving branch can receive stock' using errcode='42501'; end if; for r in select * from stock_transfer_lines where transfer_id = p_id loop insert into stock_movements (org_id, branch_id, product_id, delta, reason, note) values (t.org_id, t.to_branch, r.product_id, r.qty, 'transfer_in', 'Transfer ' || left(p_id::text, 8)); end loop; update stock_transfers set status = 'received', received_by = auth.uid(), updated_at = now() where id = p_id; end $function$

functions.name: receive_transfer
functions.def: CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION receive_transfer(p_id uuid) RETURNS void LANGUAGE plpgsql SECURITY DEFINER SET search_path TO 'public' AS $function$ declare t branch_transfers; begin select * into t from branch_transfers where id = p_id and org_id = current_org() for update; if not found or t.status <> 'in_transit' then raise exception 'Transfer is not in transit'; end if; if not can_access_branch(t.to_branch) then raise exception 'Only the receiving branch can confirm receipt' using errcode = '42501'; end if; insert into stock_movements (org_id, branch_id, product_id, delta, reason, note) values (t.org_id, t.to_branch, t.product_id, t.qty, 'transfer_in', 'Transfer ' || t.id); update branch_transfers set status = 'received', received_by = auth.uid(), received_at = now() where id = t.id; end $function$

functions.name: record_palre_compatibility_evaluation
functions.args: p_prescription_id uuid, p_design_family text, p_result_status text, p_preferred_index numeric, p_measurements jsonb, p_candidates jsonb
functions.def: CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION record_palre_compatibility_evaluation(p_prescription_id uuid, p_design_family text, p_result_status text, p_preferred_index numeric, p_measurements jsonb, p_candidates jsonb) RETURNS uuid LANGUAGE plpgsql SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp' AS $function$ declare v_org_id uuid := current_org(); v_user_id uuid := auth.uid(); v_run_id uuid; v_candidate jsonb; v_position integer:=0; v_eligible boolean; v_match_type text; begin if v_org_id is null or v_user_id is null then raise exception 'Authenticated organisation context is required'; end if; if p_design_family not in ('SV','BF','PROG','OCC') or p_result_status not in ('exact_match','nearest_eligible_match','no_eligible_match') or jsonb_typeof(coalesce(p_candidates,'[]'::jsonb))<>'array' or jsonb_typeof(coalesce(p_measurements,'{}'::jsonb))<>'object' or jsonb_array_length(coalesce(p_candidates,'[]'::jsonb))>250 then raise exception 'Invalid PALRE evaluation payload'; end if; if not exists(select 1 from profiles p where p.id=v_user_id and p.org_id=v_org_id and p.is_approved=true and p.deactivated=false and p.role_key='optometrist') then raise exception 'Only an approved optometrist can record PALRE evaluations'; end if; if not exists(select 1 from prescriptions rx where rx.id=p_prescription_id and rx.org_id=v_org_id and rx.status='active') then raise exception 'Active prescription does not belong to current organisation'; end if; insert into lens_compatibility_evaluation_runs(org_id,prescription_id,design_family,result_status,preferred_index,measurements,evaluated_by) values(v_org_id,p_prescription_id,p_design_family,p_result_status,p_preferred_index,coalesce(p_measurements,'{}'::jsonb),v_user_id) returning id into v_run_id; for v_candidate in select value from jsonb_array_elements(coalesce(p_candidates,'[]'::jsonb)) with ordinality x(value,ord) order by ord loop v_position:=v_position+1; v_eligible:=coalesce((v_candidate->>'eligible')::boolean,false); v_match_type:=case when v_eligible then coalesce(v_candidate->>'match_type','nearest_eligible') else 'ineligible' end; insert into lens_compatibility_evaluation_candidates( org_id,evaluation_run_id,lens_package_id,manufacturer_sku_snapshot,candidate_position,eligible,match_type, matched_rule_id,matched_option_combination_id,preference_score,od_result,os_result,reason_details ) values(v_org_id,v_run_id,(v_candidate->>'package_id')::uuid,nullif(v_candidate->>'manufacturer_sku',''), v_position,v_eligible,v_match_type,nullif(v_candidate->>'matched_rule_id','')::uuid, nullif(v_candidate->>'matched_option_combination_id','')::uuid,nullif(v_candidate->>'preference_score','')::numeric, coalesce(v_candidate->'od_result','{}'::jsonb),coalesce(v_candidate->'os_result','{}'::jsonb),coalesce(v_candidate->'reason_details','[]'::jsonb)); end loop; if p_result_status='no_eligible_match' and exists(select 1 from lens_compatibility_evaluation_candidates where org_id=v_org_id and evaluation_run_id=v_run_id and eligible) then raise exception 'No-match run cannot contain eligible candidates'; end if; if p_result_status='exact_match' and not exists(select 1 from lens_compatibility_evaluation_candidates where org_id=v_org_id and evaluation_run_id=v_run_id and eligible and match_type='exact') then raise exception 'Exact-match run must contain an exact eligible candidate'; end if; if p_result_status='nearest_eligible_match' and (not exists(select 1 from lens_compatibility_evaluation_candidates where org_id=v_org_id and evaluation_run_id=v_run_id and eligible and match_type='nearest_eligible') or exists(select 1 from lens_compatibility_evaluation_candidates where org_id=v_org_id and evaluation_run_id=v_run_id and eligible and match_type='exact')) then raise exception 'Nearest-match run must contain eligible nearest candidates and no exact candidate'; end if; return v_run_id; end $function$

functions.name: record_palre_recommendation_run
functions.args: p_prescription_id uuid, p_compatibility_run_ids uuid[], p_status text, p_snapshot jsonb, p_candidates jsonb
functions.def: CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION record_palre_recommendation_run(p_prescription_id uuid, p_compatibility_run_ids uuid[], p_status text, p_snapshot jsonb, p_candidates jsonb) RETURNS uuid LANGUAGE plpgsql SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp' AS $function$ declare v_org uuid:=current_org(); v_user uuid:=auth.uid(); v_run uuid; v_item jsonb; v_pos integer:=0; v_package uuid; v_match text; begin if v_org is null or v_user is null then raise exception 'Authenticated organisation required'; end if; if p_status not in ('awaiting_optometrist_review','no_eligible_match') or jsonb_typeof(coalesce(p_snapshot,'{}'::jsonb))<>'object' or jsonb_typeof(coalesce(p_candidates,'[]'::jsonb))<>'array' or jsonb_array_length(coalesce(p_candidates,'[]'::jsonb))>250 then raise exception 'Invalid recommendation run payload'; end if; if not exists(select 1 from profiles p where p.id=v_user and p.org_id=v_org and p.is_approved and not p.deactivated and p.role_key='optometrist') then raise exception 'Only approved optometrists can create recommendation runs'; end if; if not exists(select 1 from prescriptions rx where rx.id=p_prescription_id and rx.org_id=v_org and rx.status='active') then raise exception 'Active prescription not found in current organisation'; end if; if coalesce(array_length(p_compatibility_run_ids,1),0)=0 or exists( select 1 from unnest(p_compatibility_run_ids) x(id) where not exists(select 1 from lens_compatibility_evaluation_runs r where r.id=x.id and r.org_id=v_org and r.prescription_id=p_prescription_id) ) then raise exception 'Compatibility evaluation references are invalid'; end if; if p_status='no_eligible_match' and jsonb_array_length(coalesce(p_candidates,'[]'::jsonb))<>0 then raise exception 'No-match recommendation cannot contain candidates'; end if; if p_status='awaiting_optometrist_review' and jsonb_array_length(coalesce(p_candidates,'[]'::jsonb))=0 then raise exception 'Review queue recommendation requires at least one eligible candidate'; end if; insert into palre_recommendation_runs(org_id,prescription_id,status,compatibility_run_ids,recommendation_snapshot,created_by) values(v_org,p_prescription_id,p_status,coalesce(p_compatibility_run_ids,'{}'),coalesce(p_snapshot,'{}'::jsonb),v_user) returning id into v_run; for v_item in select value from jsonb_array_elements(coalesce(p_candidates,'[]'::jsonb)) with ordinality x(value,ord) order by ord loop v_pos:=v_pos+1; v_package:=(v_item->>'package_id')::uuid; v_match:=v_item->>'match_type'; if v_match not in ('exact','nearest_eligible') then raise exception 'Recommendation candidate must be clinically eligible'; end if; if not exists(select 1 from lens_compatibility_evaluation_candidates c where c.org_id=v_org and c.lens_package_id=v_package and c.eligible and c.match_type=v_match and c.evaluation_run_id=any(p_compatibility_run_ids) and exists(select 1 from lens_compatibility_evaluation_runs r where r.org_id=v_org and r.id=c.evaluation_run_id and r.design_family=v_item->>'design_family')) then raise exception 'Candidate is not eligible in the referenced compatibility run'; end if; insert into palre_recommendation_candidates(org_id,recommendation_run_id,lens_package_id,candidate_position,tier,match_type,candidate_snapshot) values(v_org,v_run,v_package,v_pos,nullif(v_item->>'tier',''),v_match,coalesce(v_item->'snapshot','{}'::jsonb)); end loop; insert into palre_recommendation_events(org_id,recommendation_run_id,event_type,actor_id,event_payload) values(v_org,v_run,case when p_status='awaiting_optometrist_review' then 'recommendation_prepared_for_optometrist_review' else 'no_eligible_match' end,v_user, jsonb_build_object('candidate_count',v_pos,'compatibility_run_ids',p_compatibility_run_ids)); return v_run; end $function$

functions.name: reject_family_member_request
functions.def: CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION reject_family_member_request(p_request_id uuid, p_reason text DEFAULT NULL::text) RETURNS void LANGUAGE plpgsql SECURITY DEFINER SET search_path TO 'public', 'auth', 'pg_temp' AS $function$ declare v_org uuid := current_org(); v_role text; begin if auth.uid() is null or v_org is null then raise exception 'Authentication required'; end if; select role_key into v_role from profiles where id = auth.uid() and is_approved = true and deactivated = false and org_id = v_org; if coalesce(v_role, '') not in ('owner','admin') then raise exception 'You are not authorised to reject family links'; end if; update family_member_requests set status = 'rejected', reviewed_at = now(), reviewed_by = auth.uid(), notes = concat_ws(E'\n', nullif(notes,''), nullif(trim(p_reason),'')) where id = p_request_id and org_id = v_org and status = 'pending'; if not found then raise exception 'Pending family request not found'; end if; end $function$

functions.name: remove_org_domain
functions.def: CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION remove_org_domain(p_domain text) RETURNS void LANGUAGE plpgsql SECURITY DEFINER SET search_path TO 'public' AS $function$ begin if not is_admin() then raise exception 'Only owners and admins can manage domains' using errcode = '42501'; end if; delete from org_domains where domain = lower(trim(p_domain)) and org_id = current_org(); end $function$

functions.name: repairs_before
functions.def: CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION repairs_before() RETURNS trigger LANGUAGE plpgsql SECURITY DEFINER SET search_path TO 'public' AS $function$ begin if tg_op = 'INSERT' then new.code := next_code(new.org_id,'repair','REP-'); else new.code := old.code; new.updated_at := now(); end if; new.total_amount := round((new.repair_charges + new.parts_cost - new.discount) * (1 + new.tax_pct/100), 2); return new; end $function$

functions.name: request_org
functions.def: CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION request_org() RETURNS uuid LANGUAGE sql STABLE SECURITY DEFINER SET search_path TO 'public' AS $function$ select coalesce(current_org(), resolve_org(nullif(current_setting('request.headers', true), '')::json ->> 'x-site-host')) $function$

functions.name: request_stock_transfer
functions.args: p_from uuid, p_to uuid, p_lines jsonb, p_note text
functions.def: CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION request_stock_transfer(p_from uuid, p_to uuid, p_lines jsonb, p_note text DEFAULT NULL::text) RETURNS uuid LANGUAGE plpgsql SECURITY DEFINER SET search_path TO 'public' AS $function$ declare v_org uuid := current_org(); v_id uuid; l jsonb; begin if v_org is null then raise exception 'Only approved staff can request transfers' using errcode='42501'; end if; if p_from = p_to then raise exception 'Choose two different branches'; end if; if not (can_access_branch(p_from) or can_access_branch(p_to)) then raise exception 'You must belong to one of the branches' using errcode='42501'; end if; if (select count(*) from branches where id in (p_from,p_to) and org_id = v_org and is_active) <> 2 then raise exception 'Invalid branches'; end if; if jsonb_typeof(p_lines) <> 'array' or jsonb_array_length(p_lines) = 0 then raise exception 'Add at least one product'; end if; insert into stock_transfers (org_id, from_branch, to_branch, note) values (v_org, p_from, p_to, p_note) returning id into v_id; for l in select * from jsonb_array_elements(p_lines) loop if (l->>'qty')::int <= 0 or not exists (select 1 from products where id = (l->>'product_id')::uuid and org_id = v_org) then raise exception 'Invalid line'; end if; insert into stock_transfer_lines (transfer_id, product_id, qty) values (v_id, (l->>'product_id')::uuid, (l->>'qty')::int); end loop; return v_id; end $function$

functions.name: request_transfer
functions.args: p_from uuid, p_to uuid, p_product uuid, p_qty integer, p_note text
functions.def: CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION request_transfer(p_from uuid, p_to uuid, p_product uuid, p_qty integer, p_note text DEFAULT NULL::text) RETURNS uuid LANGUAGE plpgsql SECURITY DEFINER SET search_path TO 'public' AS $function$ declare v_org uuid := current_org(); v_id uuid; begin if v_org is null then raise exception 'Not authorised' using errcode = '42501'; end if; if p_from = p_to then raise exception 'Choose two different branches'; end if; if not (can_access_branch(p_from) or can_access_branch(p_to)) then raise exception 'Not authorised for these branches' using errcode = '42501'; end if; if (select count(*) from branches where id in (p_from, p_to) and org_id = v_org and is_active) <> 2 then raise exception 'Branches must belong to your organisation'; end if; if not exists (select 1 from products where id = p_product and org_id = v_org) then raise exception 'Product not found'; end if; insert into branch_transfers (org_id, from_branch, to_branch, product_id, qty, note) values (v_org, p_from, p_to, p_product, p_qty, p_note) returning id into v_id; return v_id; end $function$

functions.name: resolve_org
functions.def: CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION resolve_org(p_host text DEFAULT NULL::text) RETURNS uuid LANGUAGE sql STABLE SECURITY DEFINER SET search_path TO 'public' AS $function$ select coalesce((select org_id from site_domains where host = regexp_replace(lower(coalesce(p_host,'')), '^www\.|:\d+$', '', 'g') limit 1), default_org()) $function$

functions.name: revoke_branch_access
functions.def: CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION revoke_branch_access(p_user uuid, p_branch uuid) RETURNS void LANGUAGE plpgsql SECURITY DEFINER SET search_path TO 'public' AS $function$ declare me profiles%rowtype; begin select * into me from profiles where id = auth.uid() and is_approved and not deactivated; if me.role_key not in ('owner','admin') and not (me.role_key = 'branch_manager' and can_access_branch(p_branch)) then raise exception 'Not permitted' using errcode='42501'; end if; delete from user_branches where user_id = p_user and branch_id = p_branch and org_id = me.org_id and (kind = 'temporary' or me.role_key in ('owner','admin')); end $function$

functions.name: revoke_invitation
functions.def: CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION revoke_invitation(p_id uuid) RETURNS void LANGUAGE plpgsql SECURITY DEFINER SET search_path TO 'public' AS $function$ begin if not is_admin() then raise exception 'Only owners and admins can revoke invitations' using errcode = '42501'; end if; update staff_invitations set revoked_at = now() where id = p_id and org_id = current_org() and accepted_at is null; end $function$

functions.name: revoke_temp_assignment
functions.def: CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION revoke_temp_assignment(p_id uuid) RETURNS void LANGUAGE plpgsql SECURITY DEFINER SET search_path TO 'public' AS $function$ declare a staff_assignments; begin select * into a from staff_assignments where id = p_id and org_id = current_org() for update; if not found then raise exception 'Assignment not found'; end if; if not (is_admin() or a.created_by = auth.uid() or (is_manager() and can_access_branch(a.branch_id))) then raise exception 'Not authorised' using errcode = '42501'; end if; update staff_assignments set revoked_at = now(), revoked_by = auth.uid() where id = p_id and revoked_at is null; end $function$

functions.name: sale_events_track
functions.def: CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION sale_events_track() RETURNS trigger LANGUAGE plpgsql SECURITY DEFINER SET search_path TO 'public' AS $function$ begin if tg_op = 'INSERT' then insert into sale_events (org_id, sale_id, from_status, to_status, note) values (new.org_id, new.id, null, new.status, case when new.kind = 'quotation' then 'Quotation created' else 'Order placed' end); elsif new.status is distinct from old.status then insert into sale_events (org_id, sale_id, from_status, to_status, note) values (new.org_id, new.id, old.status, new.status, null); end if; return new; end $function$

functions.name: sales_before
functions.def: CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION sales_before() RETURNS trigger LANGUAGE plpgsql SECURITY DEFINER SET search_path TO 'public' AS $function$ begin if tg_op = 'INSERT' then new.code := next_code(new.org_id, 'sale_' || new.kind, case new.kind when 'quotation' then 'Q-' else 'ORD-' end); else new.code := old.code; new.updated_at := now(); end if; return new; end $function$

functions.name: sales_trend
functions.returns: TABLE(day date, amount numeric, orders integer)
functions.def: CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION sales_trend(p_branch uuid DEFAULT NULL::uuid, p_days integer DEFAULT 14) RETURNS TABLE(day date, amount numeric, orders integer) LANGUAGE sql STABLE SET search_path TO 'public' AS $function$ select g::date, coalesce(sum(s.grand_total), 0), count(s.id)::int from generate_series((now() at time zone 'Asia/Kolkata')::date - (least(greatest(p_days, 1), 90) - 1), (now() at time zone 'Asia/Kolkata')::date, interval '1 day') g left join sales s on s.kind = 'order' and s.status <> 'cancelled' and (s.created_at at time zone 'Asia/Kolkata')::date = g::date and (p_branch is null or s.branch_id = p_branch) and s.org_id = current_org() group by 1 order by 1 $function$

functions.name: seed_org_permissions
functions.def: CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION seed_org_permissions(p_org uuid) RETURNS void LANGUAGE sql SECURITY DEFINER SET search_path TO 'public' AS $function$ insert into role_permissions (org_id, role_key, permission) select p_org, r, c.key from permission_catalog c, unnest(c.default_roles) r where r in ('branch_manager','staff') on conflict do nothing $function$

functions.name: set_profile_branches
functions.def: CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION set_profile_branches(p_profile uuid, p_branches uuid[]) RETURNS void LANGUAGE plpgsql SECURITY DEFINER SET search_path TO 'public' AS $function$ declare c profiles; t profiles; b uuid; begin select * into c from profiles where id = auth.uid() and is_approved and not deactivated; if not found or c.role_key not in ('owner', 'admin') then raise exception 'Only an owner or admin can change branch access' using errcode = '42501'; end if; select * into t from profiles where id = p_profile and org_id = c.org_id; if not found then raise exception 'Staff member not found'; end if; if t.role_key in ('owner', 'admin') then raise exception 'Owners and admins already see every branch'; end if; foreach b in array coalesce(p_branches, '{}') loop if not exists (select 1 from branches where id = b and org_id = c.org_id and is_active) then raise exception 'Branch not in your organisation'; end if; end loop; delete from profile_branches where profile_id = p_profile and branch_id <> all (coalesce(p_branches, '{}')); insert into profile_branches (profile_id, branch_id, org_id) select p_profile, x, c.org_id from unnest(coalesce(p_branches, '{}')) x on conflict do nothing; insert into audit_log (org_id, user_id, table_name, action, new_data) values (c.org_id, auth.uid(), 'profile_branches', 'set', jsonb_build_object('profile', p_profile, 'branches', p_branches)); end $function$

functions.name: set_referral_code
functions.def: CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION set_referral_code() RETURNS trigger LANGUAGE plpgsql AS $function$ begin if new.referral_code is null then new.referral_code := 'PE'||upper(substr(replace(gen_random_uuid()::text,'-',''),1,6)); end if; return new; end $function$

functions.name: set_role_permission
functions.args: p_role text, p_permission text, p_allowed boolean
functions.def: CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION set_role_permission(p_role text, p_permission text, p_allowed boolean) RETURNS void LANGUAGE plpgsql SECURITY DEFINER SET search_path TO 'public' AS $function$ begin if not is_admin() then raise exception 'Only owners and admins can change permissions' using errcode = '42501'; end if; insert into role_permissions (org_id, role_key, permission, allowed) values (current_org(), p_role, p_permission, p_allowed) on conflict (org_id, role_key, permission) do update set allowed = excluded.allowed, updated_by = auth.uid(), updated_at = now(); end $function$

functions.name: set_staff_active
functions.def: CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION set_staff_active(p_user uuid, p_active boolean) RETURNS void LANGUAGE plpgsql SECURITY DEFINER SET search_path TO 'public' AS $function$ declare v_org uuid := _staff_guard(p_user); begin if p_user = auth.uid() then raise exception 'You cannot deactivate yourself'; end if; if not p_active and (select role_key from profiles where id = p_user) = 'owner' then perform _assert_other_owner(p_user); end if; update profiles set deactivated = not p_active, is_approved = p_active where id = p_user; if not p_active then delete from user_branches where user_id = p_user and kind = 'temporary'; end if; end $function$

functions.name: set_staff_branches
functions.def: CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION set_staff_branches(p_user uuid, p_ids uuid[]) RETURNS void LANGUAGE plpgsql SECURITY DEFINER SET search_path TO 'public' AS $function$ declare v_org uuid := _staff_guard(p_user); begin if coalesce(array_length(p_ids,1),0) = 0 then raise exception 'Assign at least one branch'; end if; perform _set_branches(v_org, p_user, p_ids); end $function$

functions.name: set_staff_role
functions.def: CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION set_staff_role(p_user uuid, p_role text) RETURNS void LANGUAGE plpgsql SECURITY DEFINER SET search_path TO 'public' AS $function$ declare v_org uuid := _staff_guard(p_user, p_role); v_old text; begin if p_user = auth.uid() then raise exception 'You cannot change your own role'; end if; select role_key into v_old from profiles where id = p_user; if v_old = 'owner' and p_role <> 'owner' then perform _assert_other_owner(p_user); end if; update profiles set role_key = p_role where id = p_user; if p_role in ('owner','admin') then delete from user_branches where user_id = p_user and kind = 'permanent'; end if; end $function$

functions.name: sp_touch
functions.def: CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION sp_touch() RETURNS trigger LANGUAGE plpgsql AS $function$ begin new.updated_at := now(); return new; end $function$

functions.name: sync_auth_to_customer
functions.def: CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION sync_auth_to_customer() RETURNS trigger LANGUAGE plpgsql SECURITY DEFINER SET search_path TO 'public' AS $function$ declare v_org uuid; v_br uuid; v_name text; v_phone text; v_meta text := new.raw_user_meta_data->>'org_id'; begin if (new.raw_user_meta_data->>'is_staff') = 'true' then insert into profiles (id, full_name) values (new.id, coalesce(nullif(trim(new.raw_user_meta_data->>'full_name'), ''), split_part(new.email, '@', 1))) on conflict (id) do nothing; return new; end if; if exists (select 1 from customers where auth_user_id = new.id) then return new; end if; if v_meta ~* '^[0-9a-f]{8}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{12}$' then select id into v_org from organizations where id = v_meta::uuid; end if; if v_org is null then select id into v_org from organizations order by created_at limit 1; end if; if v_org is null then return new; end if; select id into v_br from branches where org_id = v_org and is_active order by name limit 1; v_name := coalesce(nullif(trim(new.raw_user_meta_data->>'full_name'), ''), split_part(new.email, '@', 1), 'Customer'); v_phone := coalesce(nullif(trim(new.raw_user_meta_data->>'phone'), ''), ''); insert into customers (org_id, branch_id, full_name, phone, email, auth_user_id, notes) values (v_org, v_br, v_name, v_phone, new.email, new.id, 'Auto-created from website portal'); return new; end $function$

functions.name: touch_pi_updated
functions.def: CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION touch_pi_updated() RETURNS trigger LANGUAGE plpgsql AS $function$ begin new.updated_at = now(); return new; end $function$

functions.name: touch_po_updated
functions.def: CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION touch_po_updated() RETURNS trigger LANGUAGE plpgsql AS $function$ begin new.updated_at = now(); return new; end $function$

functions.name: trg_org_seed_permissions
functions.def: CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION trg_org_seed_permissions() RETURNS trigger LANGUAGE plpgsql SECURITY DEFINER SET search_path TO 'public' AS $function$ begin perform seed_org_permissions(new.id); return new; end $function$

functions.name: validate_family_member_org
functions.def: CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION validate_family_member_org() RETURNS trigger LANGUAGE plpgsql SECURITY DEFINER SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp' AS $function$ begin if not exists (select 1 from customers c where c.id = new.primary_customer_id and c.org_id = new.org_id) then raise exception 'Primary customer must belong to the family organisation'; end if; if not exists (select 1 from customers c where c.id = new.member_customer_id and c.org_id = new.org_id) then raise exception 'Family member must belong to the same organisation'; end if; return new; end $function$

functions.name: realtime.apply_rls
functions.def: CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION realtime.apply_rls(wal jsonb, max_record_bytes integer DEFAULT (1024 * 1024)) RETURNS SETOF realtime.wal_rls LANGUAGE plpgsql AS $function$ declare -- Regclass of the table e.g. notes entity_ regclass = (quote_ident(wal ->> 'schema') || '.' || quote_ident(wal ->> 'table'))::regclass; -- I, U, D, T: insert, update ... action realtime.action = ( case wal ->> 'action' when 'I' then 'INSERT' when 'U' then 'UPDATE' when 'D' then 'DELETE' else 'ERROR' end ); -- Is row level security enabled for the table is_rls_enabled bool = relrowsecurity from pg_class where oid = entity_; subscriptions realtime.subscription[] = array_agg(subs) from realtime.subscription subs where subs.entity = entity_ -- Filter by action early - only get subscriptions interested in this action -- action_filter column can be: '*' (all), 'INSERT', 'UPDATE', or 'DELETE' and (subs.action_filter = '*' or subs.action_filter = action::text); -- Subscription vars working_role regrole; working_selected_columns text[]; claimed_role regrole; claims jsonb; subscription_id uuid; subscription_has_access bool; visible_to_subscription_ids uuid[] = '{}'; -- structured info for wal's columns columns realtime.wal_column[]; -- previous identity values for update/delete old_columns realtime.wal_column[]; -- the same values as wal2json sent them, which is what filters compare against raw_columns realtime.wal_column[] = array_agg((x->>'name', x->>'type', x->>'typeoid', x->'value', null, null)::realtime.wal_column) from jsonb_array_elements(wal -> 'columns') x; raw_old_columns realtime.wal_column[] = array_agg((x->>'name', x->>'type', x->>'typeoid', x->'value', null, null)::realtime.wal_column) from jsonb_array_elements(wal -> 'identity') x; error_record_exceeds_max_size boolean = octet_length(wal::text) > max_record_bytes; -- Primary jsonb output for record output jsonb; -- Loop record for iterating unique roles (outer loop) role_record record; -- Loop record for iterating unique selected_columns within a role (inner loop) cols_record record; -- Subscription ids visible at the role level (before fanning out by selected_columns) visible_role_sub_ids uuid[] = '{}'; begin perform set_config('role', null, true); columns = array_agg( ( x->>'name', x->>'type', x->>'typeoid', realtime.cast( (x->'value') #>> '{}', coalesce( (x->>'typeoid')::regtype, -- null when wal2json version <= 2.4 (x->>'type')::regtype ) ), (pks ->> 'name') is not null, true )::realtime.wal_column ) from jsonb_array_elements(wal -> 'columns') x left join jsonb_array_elements(wal -> 'pk') pks on (x ->> 'name') = (pks ->> 'name'); old_columns = array_agg( ( x->>'name', x->>'type', x->>'typeoid', realtime.cast( (x->'value') #>> '{}', coalesce( (x->>'typeoid')::regtype, -- null when wal2json version <= 2.4 (x->>'type')::regtype ) ), (pks ->> 'name') is not null, true )::realtime.wal_column ) from jsonb_array_elements(wal -> 'identity') x left join jsonb_array_elements(wal -> 'pk') pks on (x ->> 'name') = (pks ->> 'name'); for role_record in select claims_role from (select distinct claims_role from unnest(subscriptions)) t order by claims_role::text loop working_role := role_record.claims_role; -- Update `is_selectable` for columns and old_columns (once per role) columns = array_agg( ( c.name, c.type_name, c.type_oid, c.value, c.is_pkey, pg_catalog.has_column_privilege(working_role, entity_, c.name, 'SELECT') )::realtime.wal_column ) from unnest(columns) c; old_columns = array_agg( ( c.name, c.type_name, c.type_oid, c.value, c.is_pkey, pg_catalog.has_column_privilege(working_role, entity_, c.name, 'SELECT') )::realtime.wal_column ) from unnest(old_columns) c; if action <> 'DELETE' and count(1) = 0 from unnest(columns) c where c.is_pkey then -- Fan out 400 error per distinct selected_columns for this role for cols_record in select selected_columns from (select distinct selected_columns from unnest(subscriptions) s where s.claims_role = working_role) t order by coalesce(array_to_string(selected_columns, ','), '') loop working_selected_columns := cols_record.selected_columns; return next ( jsonb_build_object( 'schema', wal ->> 'schema', 'table', wal ->> 'table', 'type', action ), is_rls_enabled, (select array_agg(s.subscription_id) from unnest(subscriptions) as s where s.claims_role = working_role and (s.selected_columns is not distinct from working_selected_columns)), array['Error 400: Bad Request, no primary key'] )::realtime.wal_rls; end loop; -- The claims role does not have SELECT permission to the primary key of entity elsif action <> 'DELETE' and sum(c.is_selectable::int) <> count(1) from unnest(columns) c where c.is_pkey then -- Fan out 401 error per distinct selected_columns for this role for cols_record in select selected_columns from (select distinct selected_columns from unnest(subscriptions) s where s.claims_role = working_role) t order by coalesce(array_to_string(selected_columns, ','), '') loop working_selected_columns := cols_record.selected_columns; return next ( jsonb_build_object( 'schema', wal ->> 'schema', 'table', wal ->> 'table', 'type', action ), is_rls_enabled, (select array_agg(s.subscription_id) from unnest(subscriptions) as s where s.claims_role = working_role and (s.selected_columns is not distinct from working_selected_columns)), array['Error 401: Unauthorized'] )::realtime.wal_rls; end loop; else -- Create the prepared statement (once per role) if is_rls_enabled and action <> 'DELETE' then if (select 1 from pg_prepared_statements where name = 'walrus_rls_stmt' limit 1) > 0 then deallocate walrus_rls_stmt; end if; execute realtime.build_prepared_statement_sql('walrus_rls_stmt', entity_, columns); end if; -- Collect all visible subscription IDs for this role (filter check + RLS check) visible_role_sub_ids = '{}'; for subscription_id, claims in ( select subs.subscription_id, subs.claims from unnest(subscriptions) subs where subs.entity = entity_ and subs.claims_role = working_role and ( realtime.is_visible_through_filters(raw_columns, subs.filters) or ( action = 'DELETE' and realtime.is_visible_through_filters(raw_old_columns, subs.filters) ) ) ) loop if not is_rls_enabled or action = 'DELETE' then visible_role_sub_ids = visible_role_sub_ids || subscription_id; else -- Check if RLS allows the role to see the record perform -- Trim leading and trailing quotes from working_role because set_config -- doesn't recognize the role as valid if they are included set_config('role', trim(both '"' from working_role::text), true), set_config('request.jwt.claims', claims::text, true); execute 'execute walrus_rls_stmt' into subscription_has_access; -- Reset the role on every FOR..LOOP batch execution. -- The first batch of 10 rows is pre-fetched using the current connection role (PG internal behaviour) -- then we have to reset it again otherwise it would use the role defined in the `set_config` above -- to fetch the remaining rows when rows>10, which could be a user-defined role that lacks execution grants. -- The flow is: -- 1. run batch with conn role -- 2. set_config working_role -- 3. execute walrus -- 4. reset role (revert) -- 5. repeat perform set_config('role', null, true); if subscription_has_access then visible_role_sub_ids = visible_role_sub_ids || subscription_id; end if; end if; end loop; perform set_config('role', null, true); -- Inner loop: per distinct selected_columns for this role for cols_record in select selected_columns from (select distinct selected_columns from unnest(subscriptions) s where s.claims_role = working_role) t order by coalesce(array_to_string(selected_columns, ','), '') loop working_selected_columns := cols_record.selected_columns; output = jsonb_build_object( 'schema', wal ->> 'schema', 'table', wal ->> 'table', 'type', action, 'commit_timestamp', to_char( ((wal ->> 'timestamp')::timestamptz at time zone 'utc'), 'YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS.MS"Z"' ), 'columns', ( select jsonb_agg( jsonb_build_object( 'name', pa.attname, 'type', pt.typname ) order by pa.attnum asc ) from pg_attribute pa join pg_type pt on pa.atttypid = pt.oid left join ( select unnest(conkey) as pkey_attnum from pg_constraint where conrelid = entity_ and contype = 'p' ) pk on pk.pkey_attnum = pa.attnum where attrelid = entity_ and attnum > 0 and pg_catalog.has_column_privilege(working_role, entity_, pa.attname, 'SELECT') and (working_selected_columns is null or pa.attname = any(working_selected_columns) or pk.pkey_attnum is not null) ) ) -- Add "record" key for insert and update || case when action in ('INSERT', 'UPDATE') then jsonb_build_object( 'record', ( select jsonb_object_agg( -- if unchanged toast, get column name and value from old record coalesce((c).name, (oc).name), case when (c).name is null then (oc).value else (c).value end ) from unnest(columns) c full outer join unnest(old_columns) oc on (c).name = (oc).name where coalesce((c).is_selectable, (oc).is_selectable) and (working_selected_columns is null or coalesce((c).name, (oc).name) = any(working_selected_columns) or coalesce((c).is_pkey, (oc).is_pkey)) and ( not error_record_exceeds_max_size or (octet_length((c).value::text) <= 64)) ) ) else '{}'::jsonb end -- Add "old_record" key for update and delete || case when action = 'UPDATE' then jsonb_build_object( 'old_record', ( select jsonb_object_agg((c).name, (c).value) from unnest(old_columns) c where (c).is_selectable and (working_selected_columns is null or (c).name = any(working_selected_columns) or (c).is_pkey) and ( not error_record_exceeds_max_size or (octet_length((c).value::text) <= 64)) ) ) when action = 'DELETE' then jsonb_build_object( 'old_record', ( select jsonb_object_agg((c).name, (c).value) from unnest(old_columns) c where (c).is_selectable and (working_selected_columns is null or (c).name = any(working_selected_columns) or (c).is_pkey) and ( not error_record_exceeds_max_size or (octet_length((c).value::text) <= 64)) and ( not is_rls_enabled or (c).is_pkey ) -- if RLS enabled, we can't secure deletes so filter to pkey ) ) else '{}'::jsonb end; -- Filter visible_role_sub_ids to those matching the current selected_columns group visible_to_subscription_ids = coalesce( ( select array_agg(s.subscription_id) from unnest(subscriptions) s where s.claims_role = working_role and (s.selected_columns is not distinct from working_selected_columns) and s.subscription_id = any(visible_role_sub_ids) ), '{}'::uuid[] ); return next ( output, is_rls_enabled, visible_to_subscription_ids, case when error_record_exceeds_max_size then array['Error 413: Payload Too Large'] else '{}' end )::realtime.wal_rls; end loop; end if; end loop; perform set_config('role', null, true); end; $function$

functions.name: realtime.authorize
functions.args: role_name text, topic_name text, claims text, sub text, headers text, read_extensions text[], write_extensions text[], OUT read_allowed boolean[], OUT write_allowed boolean[]
functions.def: CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION realtime.authorize(role_name text, topic_name text, claims text, sub text, headers text, read_extensions text[], write_extensions text[], OUT read_allowed boolean[], OUT write_allowed boolean[]) RETURNS record LANGUAGE plpgsql AS $function$ declare probe_ids uuid[]; probe_inserted_at timestamp := now() at time zone 'utc'; visible_ids uuid[]; ext text; allowed boolean; begin -- The probe inserts are rolled back, but they still give the transaction an xid, so it ends -- in a commit. Nothing durable was written, so skip waiting on the WAL flush and sync standbys. -- Set outside the block below, whose rollback would undo it. perform set_config('synchronous_commit', 'off', true); -- The RAISE at the end of this block rolls back everything in it. begin probe_ids := array(select gen_random_uuid() from unnest(read_extensions)); insert into realtime.messages (id, topic, extension, inserted_at, updated_at) select p.id, topic_name, p.extension, probe_inserted_at, probe_inserted_at from unnest(probe_ids, read_extensions) as p(id, extension); perform set_config('role', role_name, true), set_config('realtime.topic', topic_name, true), set_config('request.jwt.claims', claims, true), set_config('request.jwt.claim.sub', sub, true), set_config('request.jwt.claim.role', role_name, true), set_config('request.headers', headers, true); -- One lookup for every probe, by the full primary key. Skipped without probes, so the -- SELECT policies are not planned for a write. if cardinality(probe_ids) > 0 then visible_ids := array( select m.id from realtime.messages m where m.inserted_at = probe_inserted_at and m.id = any(probe_ids)); end if; read_allowed := array( select p.id = any(visible_ids) from unnest(probe_ids) with ordinality as p(id, n) order by p.n); write_allowed := '{}'; foreach ext in array write_extensions loop begin insert into realtime.messages (topic, extension, inserted_at, updated_at) values (topic_name, ext, now() at time zone 'utc', now() at time zone 'utc'); allowed := true; exception when insufficient_privilege then allowed := false; end; write_allowed := write_allowed || allowed; end loop; raise sqlstate 'RTA01'; exception when sqlstate 'RTA01' then null; end; end; $function$

functions.name: realtime.broadcast_changes
functions.args: topic_name text, event_name text, operation text, table_name text, table_schema text, new record, old record, level text
functions.def: CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION realtime.broadcast_changes(topic_name text, event_name text, operation text, table_name text, table_schema text, new record, old record, level text DEFAULT 'ROW'::text) RETURNS void LANGUAGE plpgsql AS $function$ DECLARE -- Declare a variable to hold the JSONB representation of the row row_data jsonb := '{}'::jsonb; BEGIN IF level = 'STATEMENT' THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'function can only be triggered for each row, not for each statement'; END IF; -- Check the operation type and handle accordingly IF operation = 'INSERT' OR operation = 'UPDATE' OR operation = 'DELETE' THEN row_data := jsonb_build_object('old_record', OLD, 'record', NEW, 'operation', operation, 'table', table_name, 'schema', table_schema); PERFORM realtime.send (row_data, event_name, topic_name); ELSE RAISE EXCEPTION 'Unexpected operation type: %', operation; END IF; EXCEPTION WHEN OTHERS THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'Failed to process the row: %', SQLERRM; END; $function$

functions.name: realtime.build_prepared_statement_sql
functions.args: prepared_statement_name text, entity regclass, columns realtime.wal_column[]
functions.def: CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION realtime.build_prepared_statement_sql(prepared_statement_name text, entity regclass, columns realtime.wal_column[]) RETURNS text LANGUAGE sql AS $function$ /* Builds a sql string that, if executed, creates a prepared statement to tests retrive a row from *entity* by its primary key columns. Example select realtime.build_prepared_statement_sql('notes', '{"id"}'::text[], '{"bigint"}'::text[]) */ select 'prepare ' || prepared_statement_name || ' as select exists( select 1 from ' || entity || ' where ' || string_agg(quote_ident(pkc.name) || '=' || quote_nullable(pkc.value #>> '{}') , ' and ') || ' )' from unnest(columns) pkc where pkc.is_pkey group by entity $function$

functions.name: realtime.cast
functions.def: CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION realtime."cast"(val text, type_ regtype) RETURNS jsonb LANGUAGE plpgsql IMMUTABLE AS $function$ declare res jsonb; begin if type_::text = 'bytea' then return to_jsonb(val); end if; execute format('select to_jsonb(%L::'|| type_::text || ')', val) into res; return res; end $function$

functions.name: realtime.check_equality_op
functions.args: op realtime.equality_op, type_ regtype, val_1 text, val_2 text
functions.def: CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION realtime.check_equality_op(op realtime.equality_op, type_ regtype, val_1 text, val_2 text) RETURNS boolean LANGUAGE plpgsql IMMUTABLE AS $function$ /* Casts *val_1* and *val_2* as type *type_* and check the *op* condition for truthiness */ declare op_symbol text = ( case when op = 'eq' then '=' when op = 'neq' then '!=' when op = 'lt' then '<' when op = 'lte' then '<=' when op = 'gt' then '>' when op = 'gte' then '>=' when op = 'in' then '= any' else 'UNKNOWN OP' end ); res boolean; begin execute format( 'select %L::'|| type_::text || ' ' || op_symbol || ' ( %L::' || ( case when op = 'in' then type_::text || '[]' else type_::text end ) || ')', val_1, val_2) into res; return res; end; $function$

functions.name: realtime.check_equality_op
functions.args: op realtime.equality_op, type_ regtype, val_1 text, val_2 text, negate boolean
functions.def: CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION realtime.check_equality_op(op realtime.equality_op, type_ regtype, val_1 text, val_2 text, negate boolean) RETURNS boolean LANGUAGE plpgsql STABLE AS $function$ declare op_symbol text; res boolean; begin -- IS DISTINCT FROM / IS NOT DISTINCT FROM: infix, both sides typed literals if op = 'isdistinct' then execute format( 'select %L::%s %s %L::%s', val_1, type_::text, case when negate then 'IS NOT DISTINCT FROM' else 'IS DISTINCT FROM' end, val_2, type_::text ) into res; return res; end if; -- IS requires a keyword RHS (NULL, TRUE, FALSE, UNKNOWN), not a typed literal if op = 'is' then if val_2 not in ('null', 'true', 'false', 'unknown') then raise exception 'invalid value for is filter: must be null, true, false, or unknown'; end if; execute format( 'select %L::%s %s %s', val_1, type_::text, case when negate then 'IS NOT' else 'IS' end, upper(val_2) ) into res; return res; end if; op_symbol = case when op = 'eq' then '=' when op = 'neq' then '!=' when op = 'lt' then '<' when op = 'lte' then '<=' when op = 'gt' then '>' when op = 'gte' then '>=' when op = 'in' then '= any' when op = 'like' then 'LIKE' when op = 'ilike' then 'ILIKE' when op = 'match' then '~' when op = 'imatch' then '~*' else null end; if op_symbol is null then raise exception 'unsupported equality operator: %', op::text; end if; execute format( 'select %L::%s %s (%L::%s)', val_1, type_::text, op_symbol, val_2, case when op = 'in' then type_::text || '[]' else type_::text end ) into res; return case when negate then not res else res end; end; $function$

functions.name: realtime.filters_hash
functions.def: CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION realtime.filters_hash(filters realtime.user_defined_filter[]) RETURNS bytea LANGUAGE sql IMMUTABLE PARALLEL SAFE STRICT AS $function$ select pg_catalog.int8send(pg_catalog.hash_array_extended(filters, 0)) || pg_catalog.int8send(pg_catalog.hash_array_extended(filters, 1)) $function$

functions.name: realtime.is_visible_through_filters
functions.def: CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION realtime.is_visible_through_filters(columns realtime.wal_column[], filters realtime.user_defined_filter[]) RETURNS boolean LANGUAGE sql STABLE AS $function$ select filters is null or array_length(filters, 1) is null or coalesce( count(col.name) = count(1) and sum( realtime.check_equality_op( op:=f.op, type_:=coalesce(col.type_oid::regtype, col.type_name::regtype), val_1:=col.value #>> '{}', val_2:=f.value, negate:=coalesce(f.negate, false) )::int ) filter (where col.name is not null) = count(col.name), false ) from unnest(filters) f left join unnest(columns) col on f.column_name = col.name; $function$

functions.name: realtime.list_changes
functions.args: publication name, slot_name name, max_changes integer, max_record_bytes integer
functions.returns: TABLE(wal jsonb, is_rls_enabled boolean, subscription_ids uuid[], errors text[], slot_changes_count bigint)
functions.def: CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION realtime.list_changes(publication name, slot_name name, max_changes integer, max_record_bytes integer) RETURNS TABLE(wal jsonb, is_rls_enabled boolean, subscription_ids uuid[], errors text[], slot_changes_count bigint) LANGUAGE sql SET log_min_messages TO 'fatal' AS $function$ WITH pub AS ( SELECT concat_ws( ',', CASE WHEN bool_or(pubinsert) THEN 'insert' ELSE NULL END, CASE WHEN bool_or(pubupdate) THEN 'update' ELSE NULL END, CASE WHEN bool_or(pubdelete) THEN 'delete' ELSE NULL END ) AS w2j_actions, coalesce( string_agg( realtime.quote_wal2json(format('%I.%I', schemaname, tablename)::regclass), ',' ) filter (WHERE ppt.tablename IS NOT NULL), '' ) AS w2j_add_tables FROM pg_publication pp LEFT JOIN pg_publication_tables ppt ON pp.pubname = ppt.pubname WHERE pp.pubname = publication GROUP BY pp.pubname LIMIT 1 ), -- MATERIALIZED ensures pg_logical_slot_get_changes is called exactly once w2j AS MATERIALIZED ( SELECT x.*, pub.w2j_add_tables FROM pub, pg_logical_slot_get_changes( slot_name, null, max_changes, 'include-pk', 'true', 'include-transaction', 'false', 'include-timestamp', 'true', 'include-type-oids', 'true', 'format-version', '2', 'actions', pub.w2j_actions, 'add-tables', pub.w2j_add_tables ) x ), slot_count AS ( SELECT count(*)::bigint AS cnt FROM w2j WHERE w2j.w2j_add_tables <> '' ), rls_filtered AS ( SELECT xyz.wal, xyz.is_rls_enabled, xyz.subscription_ids, xyz.errors FROM w2j, realtime.apply_rls( wal := w2j.data::jsonb, max_record_bytes := max_record_bytes ) xyz(wal, is_rls_enabled, subscription_ids, errors) WHERE w2j.w2j_add_tables <> '' AND xyz.subscription_ids[1] IS NOT NULL ) SELECT rf.wal, rf.is_rls_enabled, rf.subscription_ids, rf.errors, sc.cnt FROM rls_filtered rf, slot_count sc UNION ALL SELECT null, null, null, null, sc.cnt FROM slot_count sc WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM rls_filtered) $function$

functions.name: realtime.list_changes_sync
functions.args: publication name, slot_name name, max_changes integer, max_record_bytes integer
functions.returns: TABLE(wal jsonb, is_rls_enabled boolean, subscription_ids uuid[], errors text[], slot_changes_count bigint)
functions.def: CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION realtime.list_changes_sync(publication name, slot_name name, max_changes integer, max_record_bytes integer) RETURNS TABLE(wal jsonb, is_rls_enabled boolean, subscription_ids uuid[], errors text[], slot_changes_count bigint) LANGUAGE sql SET log_min_messages TO 'fatal' AS $function$ WITH pub AS ( SELECT concat_ws( ',', CASE WHEN bool_or(pubinsert) THEN 'insert' ELSE NULL END, CASE WHEN bool_or(pubupdate) THEN 'update' ELSE NULL END, CASE WHEN bool_or(pubdelete) THEN 'delete' ELSE NULL END ) AS w2j_actions, coalesce( string_agg( realtime.quote_wal2json(format('%I.%I', schemaname, tablename)::regclass), ',' ) filter (WHERE ppt.tablename IS NOT NULL), '' ) AS w2j_add_tables FROM pg_publication pp LEFT JOIN pg_publication_tables ppt ON pp.pubname = ppt.pubname WHERE pp.pubname = publication GROUP BY pp.pubname LIMIT 1 ), -- MATERIALIZED ensures the slot is read exactly once. consumed AS MATERIALIZED ( SELECT x.*, pub.w2j_add_tables FROM pub, realtime.settled_changes( slot_name, max_changes, 'include-pk', 'true', 'include-transaction', 'false', 'include-timestamp', 'true', 'include-type-oids', 'true', 'format-version', '2', 'actions', pub.w2j_actions, 'add-tables', pub.w2j_add_tables ) x ), slot_count AS ( SELECT count(*)::bigint AS cnt FROM consumed WHERE consumed.w2j_add_tables <> '' ), rls_filtered AS ( SELECT xyz.wal, xyz.is_rls_enabled, xyz.subscription_ids, xyz.errors FROM consumed, realtime.apply_rls( wal := consumed.data::jsonb, max_record_bytes := max_record_bytes ) xyz(wal, is_rls_enabled, subscription_ids, errors) WHERE consumed.w2j_add_tables <> '' AND xyz.subscription_ids[1] IS NOT NULL ) SELECT rf.wal, rf.is_rls_enabled, rf.subscription_ids, rf.errors, sc.cnt FROM rls_filtered rf, slot_count sc UNION ALL SELECT null, null, null, null, sc.cnt FROM slot_count sc WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM rls_filtered) $function$

functions.name: realtime.quote_wal2json
functions.def: CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION realtime.quote_wal2json(entity regclass) RETURNS text LANGUAGE sql IMMUTABLE STRICT AS $function$ SELECT realtime.wal2json_escape_identifier(nsp.nspname::text) || '.' || realtime.wal2json_escape_identifier(pc.relname::text) FROM pg_class pc JOIN pg_namespace nsp ON pc.relnamespace = nsp.oid WHERE pc.oid = entity $function$

functions.name: realtime.send
functions.args: payload jsonb, event text, topic text, private boolean
functions.def: CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION realtime.send(payload jsonb, event text, topic text, private boolean DEFAULT true) RETURNS void LANGUAGE plpgsql AS $function$ DECLARE generated_id uuid; final_payload jsonb; BEGIN BEGIN generated_id := gen_random_uuid(); -- Check if payload has an 'id' key, if not, add the generated UUID IF payload ? 'id' THEN final_payload := payload; ELSE final_payload := jsonb_set(payload, '{id}', to_jsonb(generated_id)); END IF; -- Set the topic configuration EXECUTE format('SET LOCAL realtime.topic TO %L', topic); INSERT INTO realtime.messages (id, payload, event, topic, private, extension) VALUES (generated_id, final_payload, event, topic, private, 'broadcast'); EXCEPTION WHEN OTHERS THEN RAISE WARNING 'WarnSendingBroadcastMessage: %', SQLERRM; END; END; $function$

functions.name: realtime.send_binary
functions.args: payload bytea, event text, topic text, private boolean
functions.def: CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION realtime.send_binary(payload bytea, event text, topic text, private boolean DEFAULT true) RETURNS void LANGUAGE plpgsql AS $function$ DECLARE generated_id uuid; BEGIN BEGIN generated_id := gen_random_uuid(); EXECUTE format('SET LOCAL realtime.topic TO %L', topic); INSERT INTO realtime.messages (id, binary_payload, event, topic, private, extension) VALUES (generated_id, payload, event, topic, private, 'broadcast'); EXCEPTION WHEN OTHERS THEN RAISE WARNING 'WarnSendingBroadcastMessage: %', SQLERRM; END; END; $function$

functions.name: realtime.settled_changes
functions.args: slot_name name, max_changes integer, VARIADIC opts text[]
functions.returns: TABLE(lsn pg_lsn, xid xid, data text)
functions.def: CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION realtime.settled_changes(slot_name name, max_changes integer, VARIADIC opts text[]) RETURNS TABLE(lsn pg_lsn, xid xid, data text) LANGUAGE plpgsql AS $function$ declare upto pg_lsn; total bigint; xids xid[]; starts bigint[]; snapshot pg_snapshot; running_xids xid[]; xmax_age int; cut bigint; begin -- Each statement in a volatile function takes its own snapshot, which is what lets the -- check below see a writer that was still in flight when the peek ran. Under REPEATABLE -- READ the snapshot never advances, so a deferred change would never be released. if current_setting('transaction_isolation') <> 'read committed' then raise exception 'realtime.settled_changes requires READ COMMITTED'; end if; -- The peek and the read below cover the same WAL, so the read cannot reach a commit the -- check never saw. upto := pg_current_wal_flush_lsn(); -- One entry per transaction, in commit order: its xid and the position of its first -- change. The peek uses the caller's own options, so max_changes counts exactly what the -- read counts. A non-transactional logical message is emitted as soon as it is decoded, -- tagged with the xid of whatever transaction wrote it, so it does not mark where that -- transaction starts. select coalesce(sum(g.n), 0), array_agg(g.x order by g.first) filter (where g.first is not null), array_agg(g.first order by g.first) filter (where g.first is not null) into total, xids, starts from ( select p.xid as x, count(*) as n, min(p.ord) filter (where not case when starts_with(p.data, '{"action":"M"') then (p.data::jsonb->>'transactional')::boolean is false else false end) as first from pg_logical_slot_peek_changes(slot_name, upto, max_changes, variadic opts) with ordinality as p(lsn, xid, data, ord) group by p.xid ) g; -- Nothing for the caller, but the slot still has to move past what the peek covered. if total = 0 then perform pg_replication_slot_advance(slot_name, upto); return; end if; if xids is not null then -- Taken after the peek is materialized, so a writer that was still in flight during -- decoding is guaranteed to show up here. snapshot := pg_current_snapshot(); -- A commit record reaches the WAL before the writer leaves the proc array, so a change -- can be decoded while its row is invisible. apply_rls would resolve a policy against a -- row it cannot see and authorize it for nobody, while the read consumed it regardless. -- -- xip lists transactions running when the snapshot was taken. It does not cover a writer -- whose xid sits at or beyond xmax, which never appears there, so the horizon is checked -- too. age() counts backwards from the current xid and so compares correctly across -- wraparound. select coalesce(array_agg(running.x::xid), array[]::xid[]) into running_xids from pg_snapshot_xip(snapshot) running(x); xmax_age := age(pg_snapshot_xmax(snapshot)::xid); select min(u.s) into cut from unnest(xids, starts) as u(x, s) where u.x = any(running_xids) or age(u.x) <= xmax_age; end if; -- The read stops right after the commit that brings its count to upto_nchanges, so the -- count of changes in front of the first unsettled transaction stops it just before that -- transaction. if cut is null then return query select p.* from pg_logical_slot_get_changes(slot_name, upto, max_changes, variadic opts) p; elsif cut > 1 then return query select p.* from pg_logical_slot_get_changes(slot_name, upto, (cut - 1)::int, variadic opts) p; end if; end; $function$

functions.name: realtime.subscription_check_filters
functions.def: CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION realtime.subscription_check_filters() RETURNS trigger LANGUAGE plpgsql AS $function$ declare col_names text[] = coalesce( array_agg(a.attname order by a.attnum), '{}'::text[] ) from pg_catalog.pg_attribute a where a.attrelid = new.entity and a.attnum > 0 and not a.attisdropped and pg_catalog.has_column_privilege( (new.claims ->> 'role'), a.attrelid, a.attnum, 'SELECT' ); filter realtime.user_defined_filter; col_type regtype; in_val jsonb; selected_col text; begin for filter in select * from unnest(new.filters) loop if not filter.column_name = any(col_names) then raise exception 'invalid column for filter %', filter.column_name; end if; col_type = ( select atttypid::regtype from pg_catalog.pg_attribute where attrelid = new.entity and attname = filter.column_name ); if col_type is null then raise exception 'failed to lookup type for column %', filter.column_name; end if; if filter.op = 'in'::realtime.equality_op then in_val = realtime.cast(filter.value, (col_type::text || '[]')::regtype); if coalesce(jsonb_array_length(in_val), 0) > 100 then raise exception 'too many values for `in` filter. Maximum 100'; end if; elsif filter.op = 'is'::realtime.equality_op then -- `is` requires a keyword RHS rather than a typed literal if filter.value not in ('null', 'true', 'false', 'unknown') then raise exception 'invalid value for is filter: must be null, true, false, or unknown'; end if; -- IS NULL works for any type, but IS TRUE/FALSE/UNKNOWN require a boolean -- operand. Reject the non-null keywords on non-boolean columns here so they -- don't abort apply_rls at WAL time. if filter.value <> 'null' and col_type <> 'boolean'::regtype then raise exception 'is % filter requires a boolean column, got %', filter.value, col_type::text; end if; elsif filter.op in ('like'::realtime.equality_op, 'ilike'::realtime.equality_op) then -- like/ilike apply the text pattern operator (~~); reject column types that -- have no such operator instead of failing at WAL time if not exists ( select 1 from pg_catalog.pg_operator where oprname = '~~' and oprleft = col_type ) then raise exception 'operator % requires a text-compatible column type, got %', filter.op::text, col_type::text; end if; elsif filter.op in ('match'::realtime.equality_op, 'imatch'::realtime.equality_op) then -- match/imatch apply the regex operators ~ / ~*; reject column types that have -- no such operator (e.g. integer) instead of failing at WAL time, mirroring the -- like/ilike guard above. if not exists ( select 1 from pg_catalog.pg_operator where oprname = case when filter.op = 'imatch'::realtime.equality_op then '~*' else '~' end and oprleft = col_type and oprright = col_type and oprresult = 'boolean'::regtype ) then raise exception 'operator % requires a text-compatible column type, got %', filter.op::text, col_type::text; end if; -- validate the regex eagerly so a bad pattern is rejected here, not inside -- apply_rls where it would abort the WAL stream for the entity begin perform '' ~ filter.value; exception when others then raise exception 'invalid regular expression for % filter: %', filter.op::text, sqlerrm; end; else -- eq/neq/lt/lte/gt/gte: value must be coercable to the type perform realtime.cast(filter.value, col_type); end if; end loop; if new.selected_columns is not null then for selected_col in select * from unnest(new.selected_columns) loop if not selected_col = any(col_names) then raise exception 'invalid column for select %', selected_col; end if; end loop; end if; -- Apply consistent order to filters so the unique constraint can't be tricked by a -- different filter order. negate is part of the sort key. new.filters = coalesce( array_agg(f order by f.column_name, f.op, f.value, f.negate), '{}' ) from unnest(new.filters) f; -- Normalize selected_columns order so ARRAY['a','b'] and ARRAY['b','a'] are treated -- as the same subscription group in apply_rls. Preserve an empty array as '{}' -- ("primary keys only") so it stays distinct from NULL ("all columns"); array_agg -- over an empty set would otherwise collapse '{}' back to NULL. if new.selected_columns is not null then new.selected_columns = coalesce( ( select array_agg(c order by c) from unnest(new.selected_columns) c ), '{}'::text[] ); end if; return new; end; $function$

functions.name: realtime.to_regrole
functions.def: CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION realtime.to_regrole(role_name text) RETURNS regrole LANGUAGE sql IMMUTABLE AS $function$ select role_name::regrole $function$

functions.name: realtime.topic
functions.def: CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION realtime.topic() RETURNS text LANGUAGE sql STABLE AS $function$ select nullif(current_setting('realtime.topic', true), '')::text; $function$

functions.name: realtime.wal2json_escape_identifier
functions.def: CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION realtime.wal2json_escape_identifier(name text) RETURNS text LANGUAGE sql IMMUTABLE STRICT AS $function$ -- Prefix `\`, `,`, `.`, and any whitespace with `\` SELECT regexp_replace(name, '([\\,.[:space:]])', '\\\1', 'g') $function$

functions.name: storage.allow_any_operation
functions.def: CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION storage.allow_any_operation(expected_operations text[]) RETURNS boolean LANGUAGE sql STABLE AS $function$ WITH current_operation AS ( SELECT storage.operation() AS raw_operation ), normalized AS ( SELECT CASE WHEN raw_operation LIKE 'storage.%' THEN substr(raw_operation, 9) ELSE raw_operation END AS current_operation FROM current_operation ) SELECT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM normalized n CROSS JOIN LATERAL unnest(expected_operations) AS expected_operation WHERE expected_operation IS NOT NULL AND expected_operation <> '' AND n.current_operation = CASE WHEN expected_operation LIKE 'storage.%' THEN substr(expected_operation, 9) ELSE expected_operation END ); $function$

functions.name: storage.allow_only_operation
functions.def: CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION storage.allow_only_operation(expected_operation text) RETURNS boolean LANGUAGE sql STABLE AS $function$ WITH current_operation AS ( SELECT storage.operation() AS raw_operation ), normalized AS ( SELECT CASE WHEN raw_operation LIKE 'storage.%' THEN substr(raw_operation, 9) ELSE raw_operation END AS current_operation, CASE WHEN expected_operation LIKE 'storage.%' THEN substr(expected_operation, 9) ELSE expected_operation END AS requested_operation FROM current_operation ) SELECT CASE WHEN requested_operation IS NULL OR requested_operation = '' THEN FALSE ELSE COALESCE(current_operation = requested_operation, FALSE) END FROM normalized; $function$

functions.name: storage.can_insert_object
functions.args: bucketid text, name text, owner uuid, metadata jsonb
functions.def: CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION storage.can_insert_object(bucketid text, name text, owner uuid, metadata jsonb) RETURNS void LANGUAGE plpgsql AS $function$ BEGIN INSERT INTO "storage"."objects" ("bucket_id", "name", "owner", "metadata") VALUES (bucketid, name, owner, metadata); -- hack to rollback the successful insert RAISE sqlstate 'PT200' using message = 'ROLLBACK', detail = 'rollback successful insert'; END $function$

functions.name: storage.delete_lifecycle_objects
functions.returns: TABLE(id uuid, is_delete_marker boolean, metadata jsonb)
functions.def: CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION storage.delete_lifecycle_objects(object_ids uuid[]) RETURNS TABLE(id uuid, is_delete_marker boolean, metadata jsonb) LANGUAGE plpgsql AS $function$ DECLARE object_id uuid; deleted_row storage.objects%ROWTYPE; deleted_ids uuid[]; deleted_markers boolean[]; deleted_metadata jsonb[]; bulk_deleted boolean := false; BEGIN -- Surface pre-existing deferred violations instead of treating them as blocked rows. SET CONSTRAINTS ALL IMMEDIATE; PERFORM set_config('storage.allow_delete_query', 'true', true); -- One subxact keeps the subxid cache from overflowing; rows return only once it commits. BEGIN WITH deleted AS ( DELETE FROM storage.objects AS object_row WHERE object_row.id = ANY(object_ids) AND object_row.archived_at IS NOT NULL RETURNING object_row.id, object_row.is_delete_marker, object_row.metadata ) SELECT array_agg(deleted.id), array_agg(deleted.is_delete_marker), array_agg(deleted.metadata) INTO deleted_ids, deleted_markers, deleted_metadata FROM deleted; bulk_deleted := true; EXCEPTION WHEN OTHERS THEN -- User triggers may use insufficient_privilege to block a row. IF SQLSTATE <> '42501' AND left(SQLSTATE, 2) IN ('08', '40', '42', '53', '55', '57', '58', 'XX') THEN RAISE; END IF; END; IF bulk_deleted THEN RETURN QUERY SELECT * FROM unnest(deleted_ids, deleted_markers, deleted_metadata); RETURN; END IF; FOREACH object_id IN ARRAY object_ids LOOP BEGIN DELETE FROM storage.objects AS object_row WHERE object_row.id = object_id AND object_row.archived_at IS NOT NULL RETURNING object_row.* INTO deleted_row; IF FOUND THEN id := deleted_row.id; is_delete_marker := deleted_row.is_delete_marker; metadata := deleted_row.metadata; RETURN NEXT; END IF; EXCEPTION WHEN OTHERS THEN IF SQLSTATE <> '42501' AND left(SQLSTATE, 2) IN ('08', '40', '42', '53', '55', '57', '58', 'XX') THEN RAISE; END IF; END; END LOOP; END; $function$

functions.name: storage.enforce_bucket_lifecycle_service_role
functions.def: CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION storage.enforce_bucket_lifecycle_service_role() RETURNS trigger LANGUAGE plpgsql SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog' AS $function$ BEGIN IF current_user::text IS DISTINCT FROM TG_ARGV[0] THEN -- Keep this check AFTER caller RLS accepts the proposed row. The API -- recognizes this exact signal after rolling back its permission probe. RAISE EXCEPTION 'bucket control columns may only be changed by the configured storage service role' USING ERRCODE = 'PST01', SCHEMA = TG_TABLE_SCHEMA, TABLE = TG_TABLE_NAME, CONSTRAINT = TG_NAME; END IF; RETURN NULL; END; $function$

functions.name: storage.enforce_bucket_name_length
functions.def: CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION storage.enforce_bucket_name_length() RETURNS trigger LANGUAGE plpgsql AS $function$ begin if length(new.name) > 100 then raise exception 'bucket name "%" is too long (% characters). Max is 100.', new.name, length(new.name); end if; return new; end; $function$

functions.name: storage.enforce_versioning_status_transition
functions.def: CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION storage.enforce_versioning_status_transition() RETURNS trigger LANGUAGE plpgsql AS $function$ BEGIN IF NEW.versioning_status = OLD.versioning_status THEN RETURN NEW; END IF; IF NEW.versioning_status = 'DISABLED' OR (OLD.versioning_status = 'DISABLED' AND NEW.versioning_status = 'SUSPENDED') THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'Cannot transition bucket versioning status from % to %', OLD.versioning_status, NEW.versioning_status; END IF; RETURN NEW; END; $function$

functions.name: storage.extension
functions.def: CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION storage.extension(name text) RETURNS text LANGUAGE plpgsql IMMUTABLE AS $function$ DECLARE _parts text[]; _filename text; BEGIN -- Split on "/" to get path segments SELECT string_to_array(name, '/') INTO _parts; -- Get the last path segment (the actual filename) SELECT _parts[array_length(_parts, 1)] INTO _filename; -- Extract extension: reverse, split on '.', then reverse again RETURN reverse(split_part(reverse(_filename), '.', 1)); END $function$

functions.name: storage.filename
functions.def: CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION storage.filename(name text) RETURNS text LANGUAGE plpgsql IMMUTABLE AS $function$ DECLARE _parts text[]; BEGIN SELECT string_to_array(name, '/') INTO _parts; RETURN _parts[array_length(_parts, 1)]; END $function$

functions.name: storage.foldername
